jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you relish the prospect of leading strategic cross-organization, transformational programs?

Do you thrive on managing complexity?

Join our Program Management team!

Our Akamai Information Technology organization is a team of industry-leading professionals dedicated to owning and driving the innovation of Akamai's Corporate Infrastructure, Applications, Development, Security, and Compliance for our customers and corporate stakeholders Information Technology manages all aspects of the IT Program Lifecycle and the coordination and delivery of key cross-organizational strategic programs

Partner with the best

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will have end-to-end accountability for the delivery of programs. You'll lead strategic programs from planning to sustainment while reporting the program benefits to the Executive Sponsors and Governance Boards .

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will be responsible for:

Leading program definition, planning, scope, and execution of assigned programs, managing the health status of programs to anticipate risks and/or issues and implement mitigation plans
Defining integrated program plans (including detailed work breakdown structures) and the deliverables required for the program's success
Identifying dependencies and interdependencies between programs and successfully scope, size, and lead implementation of identified transformation/growth opportunities
Driving stakeholder alignment and communicating program status to executive sponsors and governance forums
Working independently and comfortably in ambiguous circumstances to create clear paths forward for teams
Adopting best-practice guidelines to influence and implement continuous improvements to PMO processes

Do What You Love

To be successful in this role you will:

Have 8 years of relevant experience and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or another related field or its equivalent
Have professional experience as a Project Manager/Program Manager in an IT organization
Have a sufficient level of technical background to provide credibility to technical teams and accurately and objectively evaluate risks and issues
Have experience working on projects/programs supporting Enterprise Applications
Have experience managing external implementation providers
Demonstrate solid leadership, coaching, and interpersonal skills in addition to excellent presentation and communication abilities
Have a successful track record of stakeholder management and leading effective communication across senior leadership and technical teams

About Us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our Focus Is Simple

Cloud and Edge:
Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

Security
: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.

Content Delivery
: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.

AI
: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai:
We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Compensation

Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - the base salary for this position ranges from $119,600 - $215,400/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. Compensation for candidates outside the US will vary. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Akamai provides industry-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation (in the form of PTO), sick time, family friendly benefits including parental leave and an employee assistance program including a focus on mental and financial wellness; Eligibility requirements apply.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Project Manager manages all aspects of a project, from start to finish, so that it is completed on time and within budget. The Senior Project Manager work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

The Senior Project Manager designs, communicates, and implements an operational plan for completing the project; monitors progress and performance against the project plan; takes action to resolve operational problems and minimize delays. Identifies, develops, and gathers the resources to complete the project. Prepares designs and work specifications; develops project schedules, budgets and forecasts; and selecting materials, equipment, project staff, and external contractors. Communicates with other operational areas in the organization to secure specialized resources and contributions for the project. Conducts meetings and prepare reports to communicate the status of the project. Sets priorities, allocates tasks, and coordinates project staff to meet project targets and milestones. Begins to influence department's strategy. Makes decisions on moderately complex to complex issues regarding technical approach for project components, and work is performed without direction. Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in both traditional project management and adaptable or Agile approaches.
3 or more years of experience leading complex projects or programs.
Strong communication skills both written and verbal
Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver outcomes in a matrixed environment.
Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working across multiple business areas, technical teams, vendors, and leadership stakeholders.
Project management certification such as PMP, PMI-ACP, or similar.
Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, change management, or process improvement training may be helpful.

Additional Information

As part of our hiring process for this opportunity, we will be using an interviewing technology called HireVue to enhance our hiring and decision-making ability. jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

DWP Digital is a leading division within the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP), dedicated to transforming public services through innovative digital solutions. With a focus on delivering efficient, accessible, and user-centric services, DWP Digital harnesses the latest technology to support millions of citizens across the UK. The organization is committed to fostering a collaborative environment that encourages continuous learning, professional growth, and the development of cutting-edge digital products that make a tangible difference in people's lives.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Digital Project Manager to join our dynamic team at DWP Digital. In this role, you will be responsible for leading complex digital projects from initiation through to successful delivery, ensuring they meet scope, time, quality, and budget requirements. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and external partners to drive project success and ensure alignment with organizational objectives. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership qualities, excellent communication skills, and a proven track record in managing digital transformation initiatives within a government or large enterprise setting.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will have a relevant bachelor’s degree in project management, information technology, or a related field. Professional certifications such as PMP, Prince2, or Agile certifications are highly desirable. Extensive experience in managing digital projects, preferably within the public sector, is essential. Candidates should demonstrate strong knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and best practices. Excellent stakeholder management skills, the ability to navigate complex organizational structures, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are crucial. Familiarity with government digital standards and policies will be considered an advantage.

Responsibilities

As a Digital Project Manager, your responsibilities will include planning and defining project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders. You will develop detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets, ensuring efficient resource allocation. Managing project risks, issues, and changes will be a key aspect of your role, along with monitoring progress and providing regular updates to senior management. You will facilitate communication among project teams, ensure adherence to governance frameworks, and promote best practices in project management. Additionally, you will oversee procurement processes, manage vendor relationships, and ensure compliance with relevant policies and standards. Your role will also involve fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within project teams.

Benefits

Joining DWP Digital offers a competitive benefits package, including a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance. Employees have access to generous pension schemes, ample holiday entitlement, and comprehensive health and wellbeing programs. The organization promotes professional development through ongoing training, certifications, and career progression opportunities. DWP Digital also provides an inclusive workplace culture that values diversity and encourages collaboration, creativity, and innovation. Additionally, employees benefit from modern facilities and a supportive community that fosters personal growth and achievement.

Equal Opportunity

DWP Digital is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We value diversity and are dedicated to ensuring that all individuals are treated fairly and with respect, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other characteristic protected by law. We actively encourage applications from underrepresented groups and strive to provide equitable opportunities for career advancement and professional development. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion is integral to our mission of delivering excellent digital services to the public.

Company Background

Emeritus has partnered with more than 50 universities to date including MIT, Columbia, Harvard, Cambridge, INSEAD, Wharton, UC Berkeley, INCAE, IIT, IIM, NUS and HKUST, launching more than 200 courses and serving students from more than 80 countries. Many courses are offered and facilitated in multiple languages, including English, Spanish, Portuguese,
and Mandarin. Emeritus’ global team includes 1200+ employees located in Boston, Dubai, Mexico City, Mumbai, Shanghai and Singapore.

Key responsibilities of the role

We are looking for an experienced Program Manager to support the operations and delivery of our blended, online and custom curated programs for our Enterprise clients across Europe Region. The Responsibilities include:

• Serve as primary day-to-day point of contact for client interactions and work with them on interdependencies to ensure program is launched as per timelines

• 6-10 years of experience in managing delivery and operations of learning journeys

• Ability to communicate fluently, both verbally and written

jobs.title: Principal Program Manager, 2 Hour Learning (Remote) - $200,000/year USD
jobs.description:
You’ve built dashboards. Tracked milestones. Chased vendors. Flagged risks. But your reports hit a ceiling. You weren’t the one making the calls.

2 Hour Learning is building an AI-powered education model designed to help students achieve a full day of academic progress in just two hours. Making that model work at scale requires dozens of initiatives, technology partners, contracts, and investment decisions to move in sync. Your job is to make the execution layer trustworthy enough for executives to act on it.

You will own the operating outputs behind those decisions: portfolio dashboards that expose slippage before it becomes a surprise, vendor scorecards tied to real contractual commitments, competitive bid packages that make trade-offs clear, and contract controls that prevent unsupported spend. AI will be part of your daily workflow, helping you standardize updates, detect anomalies, compare bids, analyze vendor performance, and validate invoices.

This is not a PMO role built around meetings, process compliance, or polished status decks. It is for an operator who wants their work to have consequences. When a vendor underperforms, your evidence should make that obvious. When spend drifts from the contract, your controls should catch it. When executives need to make a $5M decision, your outputs should give them the confidence to make it fast. If that sounds like the level of ownership you have been looking for, apply.

What You Will Be Doing

Own portfolio-level dashboards across 10+ concurrent initiatives, using AI to standardize updates, detect slippage, expose blockers, and maintain a trusted executive view of delivery, budget, and risk
Run recurring vendor performance reviews and maintain rubric-based scorecards that combine delivery, quality, cost, contractual commitments, and qualitative performance signals
Lead competitive technology-vendor procurement, including structured bid packages, normalized comparisons, scoring rubrics, SOW development, and evidence-backed recommendations
Govern contracts and invoices by tracking fee caps, milestones, acceptance criteria, and amendments, then validating invoices against signed terms before spend is approved
Use AI daily to analyze portfolio data, detect anomalies, surface underperformance, draft decision-ready outputs, and reduce manual PMO administration

What You Won’t Be Doing

Producing status reports that executives read but never use to make decisions
Running a meeting-heavy PMO where coordination matters more than measurable execution
Treating vendor management as relationship maintenance while missed commitments go unchallenged
Passing contracts, SOWs, invoices, or procurement decisions to someone else because they look too commercial or technical
Using AI as an occasional productivity trick instead of a core part of how you operate

Principal Program Manager Key Responsibilities

Your mandate is to produce reliable, AI-powered dashboards, scorecards, procurement packages, and contract controls that give executives the clarity and leverage to hold vendors accountable, control costs, and accelerate delivery across a $50M EdTech portfolio.

Basic Requirements

Directly owned a portfolio of 10+ concurrent initiatives with at least $5M in budget responsibility, including authority over budget allocation, vendor selection, or initiative prioritization
Managed 5+ external technology vendors at the same time, such as SaaS providers, AI/ML platforms, marketing agencies, or engineering firms
Built and maintained portfolio-level dashboards covering metrics such as delivery health, budget burn versus forecast, milestone completion, and major risks or blockers
Can point to a case where C-suite leaders used your portfolio data to make a go/no-go decision on a vendor renewal, budget reallocation, or initiative deprioritization
Directly led competitive technology procurement, including structured bid evaluation, vendor scoring, negotiation, and selection
Authored or co-authored SOWs with measurable deliverables, milestone payments, SLAs, acceptance criteria, or other performance-based terms
Negotiated commercial terms such as pricing, penalties, fee caps, or exit clauses and enforced those terms through invoice validation or corrective action
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex financial and operational data into concise recommendations executives can act on
Able to analyze financial and vendor-performance data quickly enough to recommend optimization, reallocation, or vendor elimination
Able to work US business hours

Nice-to-have Requirements

Experience using AI-enabled dashboards, anomaly detection, predictive alerts, or natural-language analysis in portfolio management
Experience in EdTech, technology, consulting, or another environment managing complex portfolios of external technology partners
Fluency with portfolio and delivery tools such as Linear, Jira, or similar systems

About 2 Hour Learning

Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one-size-fits-all model and replacing it with AI-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.

With students consistently ranking in the top 1-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.

They offer a dynamic, on-campus and remote-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.

2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.

Here’s How They’re Fixing It.

There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $100 USD/hour, which equates to $200,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. jobs.description:

👥 : People & Organization

📍 : Bucuresti

📝 : contract pe perioada nedeterminata prin colaboratorii de la Humangest

#DămEnergieTalentuluiTău

Tranziția energetică se întâmplă prin oameni care își văd rolul dincolo de task-uri și știu că ceea ce fac are un impact real.

La PPC, contribuim zi de zi la un sistem energetic mai sigur și mai curat, de la rețelele care conectează comunități, la energia regenerabilă care schimbă mixul energetic sau soluțiile care fac mobilitatea electrică accesibilă.

Indiferent de rol, contribuția noastră se reflectă în fiecare zi în comunitățile pe care le deservim, în clienții care ne aleg și într-un sistem energetic care evoluează constant. Suntem prezenți pe întreg lanțul valorii energetice și căutăm oameni motivați care sa ni se alăture.

Dacă ai curiozitatea de a înțelege lucrurile în profunzime, responsabilitatea de a le duce până la capăt și deschiderea de a lucra într-un mediu în continuă schimbare, atunci locul tău e alături de noi.

Ce vei face

În rolul acesta, vei avea ocazia să contribui la un scop mai mare decât task-urile de zi cu zi: acela de a face energia mai sigură, mai sustenabilă și mai aproape de oameni.

Îți creăm contextul să te dezvolți, avand urmatoarele responsabilităti:

Asigură securitatea, integritatea și conformitatea cu reglementările legale a sediilor, personalului și operațiunilor de securitate ale companiei, prin coordonarea documentației, a autorizațiilor și a activităților de control, sub îndrumarea Managerului de Departament.
Susține îmbunătățirea continuă și fiabilitatea sistemelor și proceselor de monitorizare a securității, prin coordonarea implementării la nivel de furnizori, a upgrade-urilor de software și a instruirii tehnice a echipei operaționale.
Contribuie la un cadru de securitate și integritate consecvent, conform și etic la nivelul întregii companii, prin susținerea dezvoltării și implementării politicilor și procedurilor associate.
Asigură raportarea la timp și corectă a performanței departamentului de securitate către Managerul de Integritate, Persoane și Securitate, pentru a susține decizii informate și pregătirea pentru continuitatea afacerii.
Coordonează și susține planificarea activităților și resurselor de securitate pentru echipa alocată, sub îndrumarea Managerului de Departament, pentru a asigura acoperirea eficientă și coordonarea fluentă a operațiunilor zilnice de securitate.
Coordonează pregătirea și actualizarea documentației necesare pentru autorizațiile legate de securitate, sub supravegherea Managerului de Departament, pentru a susține conformitatea legală și de reglementare.
Susține și coordonează înlocuirea software-ului de monitorizare a sistemelor de securitate, inclusiv specificațiile tehnice, coordonarea cu furnizorii, implementarea pilot și finală, tranziția furnizorului de servicii de date și instruirea operatorilor tehnici, pentru a îmbunătăți capacitățile de monitorizare operațională.
Coordonează actualizarea planurilor de securitate în conformitate cu cerințele legale și interne, sub îndrumarea Managerului de Departament, pentru a susține conformitatea continuă cu reglementările.
Propune și susține implementarea de noi sisteme de securitate pentru a îmbunătăți monitorizarea personalului și climatul general de securitate, contribuind la un nivel mai ridicat de protecție la nivelul companiei.
Monitorizează activitatea și calitatea serviciilor furnizorilor de servicii de securitate, contribuie la planul anual de continuitate a activității și întocmește rapoarte lunare și trimestriale privind performanța departamentului pentru Managerul de Integritate, Persoane și Securitate, pentru a susține operațiuni de securitate fiabile și continue.
Susține dezvoltarea și implementarea politicilor de securitate și integritate la nivelul departamentului și al companiei, sub coordonarea Managerului de Departament, pentru a promova un cadru de securitate consecvent, conform și etic.

Dorim să te alături în călătoria noastră cu:

Studii superioare finalizate cu diploma de licenta
8-10+ ani de experiență progresivă în domeniul securității fizice
5+ ani de experiență progresivă în operațiuni de securitate, inclusiv experiență de supervizare
MS Office
Platforme de monitorizare a securității și control al accesului (VMS, Web TS, Time & Space Manager)
Managementul proiectelor

Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

The Job

supports the development, implementation, and ongoing management of initiatives designed to improve market and provider performance across the organization. This role partners with Market Performance leaders, Provider Relations, Analytics, and functional subject matter experts to coordinate performance improvement programs, perform market research, develop reporting and insights, monitor key performance indicators, and drive execution and project coordination of strategic initiatives, The Senior Program Manager plays a critical role in translating performance strategies into operational plans, ensuring consistent implementation across markets, tracking outcomes, and helping to identify opportunities for improvement in quality, growth, member experience, provider performance, access to care, and affordability.

r is responsible for overseeing and managing multiple projects within the Market Performance Center of Excellence. You're the program manager who can land Multi-Tiered System of Supports MTSS Level 3 across multiple public districts, not just one campus. You build district-specific implementation plans, run engaging PD that actually changes practice, and stand up ongoing support that solves problems the first time. You track adoption and student performance with rigor, turn that data into clear next steps, and you keep refining the playbook so the next rollout is faster and cleaner.

You know MTSS/RTI cold, speak K-12 fluently, and you can earn trust with educators while running a tight project timeline.

We're standardizing a high-leverage, Level 3 intervention and scaling it with technology so districts see measurable student gains sooner, at lower friction. That means less bespoke consulting, more repeatable wins. If you like building repeatable systems that outperform “heroic effort,” this is where the work pays off: a forward-thinking, entrepreneurial team that values autonomy and expects you to shape how the intervention scales.

This is not a district MTSS coordinator job focused on one system's politics. It's a multi-district implementation role that scales a standardized, outcome-driven solution. It's not a classic EdTech implementation coordinator either; your scorecard is adoption quality and student outcomes. Compared to a private-K12 CSM, you're not stewarding individual accounts; you're standing up an intervention program across public districts and proving it works, then making it easier to repeat.

You'll manage implementations across multiple public school districts simultaneously, balancing stakeholder alignment, educator enablement, and measurable adoption outcomes. You'll partner with product and ops, turn field feedback into improvements, and be the person districts remember when the implementation works and students move. If you can design and execute tailored timelines, deliver training people want to attend, mine usage and performance data for truth, and iterate processes without waiting for permission, step in. The right candidate will recognize themselves here and should apply.

What You Will Be Doing

Leading district implementation rollouts from kickoff through sustained adoption of our MTSS framework
Designing and executing district implementation plans that drive high adoption of our MTSS framework
Tracking implementation fidelity, adoption trends, and student performance data to identify improvement opportunities
Delivering engaging professional development that leaves educators confident and excited about using our solution
Refining implementation playbooks and operational processes so each rollout becomes faster and more repeatable

What You Won’t Be Doing

Developing custom one-off solutions instead of implementing our proven, standardized approach
Focusing on post-implementation account management rather than driving successful adoption
Getting buried in administrative paperwork instead of driving meaningful outcomes
Working with a single district rather than implementing across multiple school systems

Educational Program Manager Key Responsibilities

Lead high-fidelity district implementation of our technology-enabled MTSS framework so educators adopt it consistently and students receive faster, more effective intervention support.

Basic Requirements

At least 2 years of experience in K-12 education in MTSS (Multi-Tiered System of Supports), RTI (Response to Intervention), or program coordination
Experience analyzing student performance data and turning findings into actionable next steps
Located in the United States and willing to travel up to 30% for on-site training
Eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, GBPS Services
jobs.description:
Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life.

Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources. 

Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration.

This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible.

Job posting end date: 10/21/2026

Drive Customer Success with Metso

At Metso, we empower our customers to operate more efficiently, safely, and sustainably. As a global leader in minerals processing technologies, we design and deliver solutions that shape the future of our industry.

Our projects combine complex engineering with precision execution—and we rely on exceptional project leaders to bring them to life.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the execution of engineered to order (ETO) mineral processing equipment and systems with particular focus on selected Bulk Materials Handling solutions, for major customers around the world. This role is ideal for a confident, results driven professional who excels in complex project delivery and thrives in a collaborative, high performance environment.

Your Role and Impact

As Senior Project Manager, you will take full ownership of major ETO projects—ranging from individual process equipment packages to integrated plant level systems. You will drive delivery across engineering, procurement, fabrication, logistics, installation, and commissioning, ensuring safety, quality, timeline, and financial targets are met.

Your leadership will shape customer relationships, influence internal stakeholders, and set the standard for execution excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end delivery of complex ETO mineral processing projects with full responsibility for scope, budget, schedule, and risk management.
Establish strong customer relationships and serve as their primary point of contact throughout project execution.
Drive cross functional coordination with engineering, supply chain, quality, manufacturing, logistics, and field service teams.
Oversee project controls: cost forecasting, progress measurement, change management, claims, and reporting.
Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, and safety standards.
Lead design reviews, progress meetings, supplier evaluations, FATs, and site readiness assessments.
Provide leadership, guidance, and mentoring to junior project team members.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and contribute to bestpractice development within the PMO.
Support commercial and tendering teams with project execution insights, risk assessments, and customer engagement.

What You Bring

You are a confident project leader who has experience delivering complex ETO solutions to large multinational mining companies. You have strong commercial acumen, technical understanding, and the ability to drive progress in complex, multidisciplinary environments. You are proactive, structured, and skilled at balancing customer expectations with operational realities. You have exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Process, Electrical, or Civil Engineering, or equivalent technical field.
7+ years of project management experience, ideally in bulk materials handling port solutions, minerals processing, engineered to order equipment, or similar domains.
Demonstrated success in managing largescale, multiphase projects with significant technical and commercial complexity.
Demonstrated ability to manage delivery projects for large multinational mining companies operating in Western Australia
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Solid understanding of project controls, contract management, and risk mitigation.
Proficiency in project management and ERP tools (SAP, MS Project or similar).
Ability to travel domestically and internationally as project needs require.
PMP Certification highly regarded

What We Offer

At Metso, you will be part of a global team committed to innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement. We provide:

A leadership role with influence across high visibility customer projects.
Extensive learning opportunities - ongoing growth dialogues, internal mobility, mentoring programs, education assistance, ambitious projects, and global opportunities.
Wellbeing and safety - benefit from occupational healthcare, generous benefits plan, healthy living rewards, mental well-being services, on-site gym, meal benefits, car/bicycle benefits, and engagement surveys.
Annual bonus - global incentive programs tied to business and performance targets.
Hybrid working possibilities - while we are big advocates of meeting and collaborating in person, we believe in fostering a flexible work environment.
Worldwide support - leverage our network of peers across the world, offering valuable assistance. We get things done together, through open and honest communication.
A thriving culture – we are committed to developing an inclusive culture that enables everyone to do their best and reach their full potential. A culture that is courageous, compelling, and caring, and unites our people to build a sustainable future together.
A work environment where safety is always the number one priority – both your physical and mental health is our priority
A competitive base salary reflective of your skills and experience with annual incentive program
Additional Annual Leave benefit - your health and wellbeing is a priority, increase your leave entitlement with every year you work at Metso.
Gender neutral parental leave - 18 weeks paid in full
Paid Volunteer Leave so you can give back to the local community or an organisation of your choice
Comprehensive medical benefits including discounted private health insurance for employees and immediate family
Novated lease - this benefit allows you to save on a new car and potentially enjoy significant tax savings
Various leisure benefits including discounted car rental and accommodation for leisure travel around the world.

Metso is committed to pay equity and transparent reward practices globally. Compensation information is shared in line with local legislation and applicable recruitment practices.

How to join - Working at Metso - About Metso - Diversity and Inclusion - Meet our people

Metso is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers’ energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change.

Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. Metso is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

About StanceBeam

Bengaluru-headquartered sports technology company. Built the world's first commercial smart cricket bat sensor; now a full AI and computer-vision stack for cricket, deployed across India, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, the UK and the US. KPMG Game Changers Award, Karnataka Elevate100, granted patent portfolio.
Office-based, Embassy Tech Square, Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru. Reports to the founders.
Compensation in line with experience.

The role

StanceBeam builds AI and computer-vision based solution for sports: smart bat sensor analytics, multi-camera ball tracking, shot and delivery recognition and automated decision-review technology. We license these IPs to sports organisations worldwide and customise it into their platforms and operations under long-term enterprise contracts.
You will run delivery for these engagements: plan, scope, change control, release and the client relationship. The scope covers iOS/Android and tablet apps, web admin portals, backend and integrations (hardware, access control, payments, analytics), and the firmware, calibration and AI model updates underneath. You work directly with the founders and the client
.

Responsibilities

Day-to-day client contact for product and operations teams; run weekly working sessions, demos and release walkthroughs.
Own the delivery plan and backlog sequencing against set priorities
Assess change requests for scope, effort and timeline; escalate commercial or contractual impact.
Plan around hardware lead times and model release cycles (data, validation, staged rollout); set client expectations on accuracy and limits.
Run Agile sprint planning, refinement and reviews with the Technical Lead and QA; maintain written acceptance criteria.
Coordinate client UAT; triage findings and drive the fix list to closure.
Own release readiness: release notes, environment checks, sign-off, go/no-go.
Produce SOPs, admin playbooks, training and support documentation for each launch.
Keep decisions, status and risks in writing; flag slips before they happen.

Requirements

in delivery, technical programme or product management with direct ownership of scope, plans and client commitments.
Shipped at least one product combining software with hardware, sensors, IoT or devices in the field.
Working understanding of AI/ML and computer vision as product components: model lifecycle, validation, accuracy ranges, drift.
Has run client meetings and UAT independently; strong written English for cross-time-zone communication.
Reads specs and API contracts; can challenge an estimate constructively.
Agile delivery in practice; Jira or Azure Boards, Confluence, Figma, Postman.
Regular overlap with US/UK/Australia clients; overseas travel a few times a year.

Preferred

Engineering or CS degree, or prior technical role at start-ups.
Delivered a product where an ML or vision model was part of the client deliverable.
PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent; experience with clients in North America, UK, Australia or the Gulf.
Interest in cricket or sports technology.

Small senior team, no layers. We want independent thinkers who solve problems without being assigned them, work through ambiguity, and follow through without being chased. Start-up mindset: outcomes over process.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Project Manager
jobs.description:
Home. There’s no place like it.

And there’s no feeling like helping people create the joy of feeling truly at home. At Dunelm, that’s what we do. We’re the UK's number one choice for homewares because we make home life lovelier for our customers. And we’ve crafted a workplace that feels just as welcoming – where you can bring your ideas, be yourself, and feel right at home.

Work your way, together

We’re a hybrid business, which means you’ll have flexibility alongside time together with your team. In this role, you can expect 1-2 days per week in our Leicester office, helping you stay connected, collaborate and do your best work for our customers.

This role will help turn Dunelm’s cyber priorities into clear, well-managed delivery, coordinating people, plans, partners and decisions across a changing security landscape.

You will work with the Cyber Programme Manager, Information Security teams, Technology colleagues, business stakeholders and external partners to deliver assigned Cyber Security, Identity, Audit and Resilience projects.

You will bring structure without unnecessary bureaucracy, making scope, milestones, ownership, risks and decisions clear while helping technical teams focus on delivery. You do not need to be the deepest technical expert in the room, but you will need to be cyber awareness and curiosity to ask good questions, understand risk and bring the right people together.

What you’ll be doing

Project delivery and planning

Lead assigned cyber security projects and workstreams from definition through delivery, adoption and handover into business as usual.
Turn agreed outcomes into practical plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, decision points and delivery dates.
Maintain proportionate project controls covering risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, actions, decisions and change.
Create a clear, evidence-based view of delivery confidence and escalate material risks early with options and recommendations.

Governance, audit and reporting

Establish fit-for-purpose governance and reporting that supports timely decisions without creating unnecessary administration.
Coordinate delivery against regulatory, audit and control commitments, making sure scope, evidence, ownership and closure criteria are understood.
Prepare concise updates for leadership, risk, audit and programme forums, tailored to the audience and decision required.
Support transition of project outcomes into sustainable operational ownership, controls and ways of working.

Collaboration and delivery leadership

Bring together Cyber, Platform Operations, Product, Engineering, Architecture, Service Management, business teams and external partners around shared outcomes.
Facilitate workshops and working sessions that clarify problems, resolve blockers and create accountable next steps.
Help teams prioritise delivery within competing operational and project demands, while protecting time for critical commitments.
Build trusted relationships and create an environment where risks and uncertainty can be raised early and handled constructively.

Partner and commercial delivery

Coordinate third-party delivery against agreed scope, milestones, quality, security and service expectations.
Support statements of work, onboarding, delivery reviews and supplier governance in partnership with Commercial, Legal and senior stakeholders.
Ensure external dependencies, commitments and risks are visible and actively managed.

Continuous improvement

Improve project ways of working through feedback, retrospectives and practical use of data, automation and collaboration tools.
Reuse simple, effective delivery patterns across projects while adapting governance to the scale and risk of the work.

What we’ll look for in you

Essential experience and skills

Experience delivering cross-functional technology, cyber security, risk, compliance or operational resilience projects.
Strong project planning, governance, RAID and dependency-management skills, with the ability to create clarity from incomplete or changing information.
Experience coordinating technical teams, business stakeholders and third-party partners to deliver agreed outcomes.
Clear, concise communication skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders, specialists and delivery teams.
Ability to translate risk, audit or control requirements into practical delivery plans and evidence-based status reporting.
Good commercial awareness, including management of scope, resource, suppliers, timelines and delivery trade-offs.
Working knowledge of Agile and traditional project-delivery approaches, with judgement to use proportionate methods.

Desirable skills

Experience delivering identity and access management, security operations, cyber resilience, audit remediation or governance projects.
Familiarity with common cyber and risk concepts such as access control, privileged access, security monitoring, incident response, third-party risk and disaster recovery.
Experience working in a regulated, retail or multi-site organisation.
Experience supporting supplier selection, onboarding or managed-service transition.
Relevant project-management or cyber security qualification.
Awareness and delivery of NIST Maturity, Cyber Essentials, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, Provision 29 would be an advantage.

Behaviours

Calm, pragmatic and organised, with a focus on outcomes rather than process for its own sake.
Curious and willing to challenge constructively when scope, ownership or evidence is unclear.
Takes responsibility, follows through on commitments and helps others do the same.
Builds trust through transparency, inclusive collaboration and early escalation of risks.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity while creating a credible route forward.

Manage SaaS tools, licences, vendors and renewals, including third-party risk assessments and cost optimisation with Business Operations.

Practical experience administering Microsoft 365 and identity and access management environments.
Experience managing SaaS tools, licenses, technology vendors and external IT providers.

Reporting to the Data Privacy Officer (DPO), the eDiscovery Project Manager will work with the eDiscovery Manager by providing technical support, predominantly on file reviews, transfers and data subject access requests (DSARs), as part of the Firm’s in-house compliance and regulatory requirements. In addition, the eDiscovery Project Manager may be required to assist fee-earning teams, such as Employment, Litigation and Dispute Resolution, with eDiscovery for disputes and claims.

The ideal candidate will possess knowledge of litigation, DSARs and file transfer processes, document management and access to data and data organisation, have a broad range of experience in applied technology and be able to make recommendations to improve our practices and implement the best technical and practical solutions.

Roles and Responsibilities 

Manage end-to-end eDiscovery projects across the firm, including scoping, data collection, processing, review, and production for both internal compliance matters and fee earner client work.

Partner with fee-earning teams across practice areas including Litigation, Employment, Dispute Resolution, and Corporate to deliver eDiscovery support for disputes, investigations, and transactional due diligence.

Advise stakeholders on eDiscovery best practices, technology solutions, and defensible workflows to ensure efficient and compliant handling of electronically stored information.

Support the selection, implementation, and ongoing management of eDiscovery platforms and tools, ensuring they meet the needs of both compliance and client-facing work.

Coordinate data collection and preservation activities, working with IT, Information Security, and matter teams to ensure defensibility and chain of custody.

Develop and maintain eDiscovery workflows, protocols, and quality control procedures to ensure consistency and accuracy across all projects.

Provide training and support to fee earners, paralegals, and support staff on eDiscovery processes, tools, and technology-assisted review methodologies.

Support the eDiscovery Manager, DPO and GCO team with data subject access requests (DSARs), file reviews, and other regulatory compliance matters as required.

Liaise with external eDiscovery vendors and service providers, managing relationships and ensuring cost-effective delivery of services.

Prepare and manage project budgets, timelines, and reporting, keeping stakeholders informed of progress and any issues.

Stay current with developments in eDiscovery technology, legal requirements, and industry best practices, recommending improvements to the firm’s capabilities.

Comply with all relevant legal and regulatory obligations including the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Standards and Regulations, and Principles.

Skills and Experience

Essential

Demonstrable experience in eDiscovery project management within a law firm, legal services provider, or corporate legal department.

Strong working knowledge of eDiscovery platforms and tools (e.g. Relativity, Nuix, Concordance, or similar).

Understanding of the litigation lifecycle, disclosure obligations under the Civil Procedure Rules, and data protection legislation including UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.

Experience managing data collection, processing, review, and production workflows.

Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver to deadlines.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable

Relevant professional qualification or certification in eDiscovery, project management, or information governance (e.g. ACEDS, CIPP, PRINCE2, or equivalent).

Experience with technology-assisted review (TAR), predictive coding, or AI-powered review tools.

Experience handling data subject access requests (DSARs) and regulatory investigations.

Knowledge of digital forensics principles and data preservation techniques.

Experience working with external eDiscovery vendors and managing third-party service providers.

Person Specification

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and legal concepts clearly to diverse audiences including fee earners, clients, and IT teams.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a methodical approach to managing large volumes of data and identifying efficient solutions.

Highly organised with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when working under pressure or to tight deadlines.

Adaptable and resilient, able to respond effectively to changing priorities and manage competing demands across multiple projects.

Collaborative team player who builds trusted working relationships and works effectively across departments and with external providers.

Proactive and self-motivated, with the confidence to take ownership of projects and drive them through to completion.

Commercial awareness with an understanding of how eDiscovery supports client service delivery and the firm’s business objectives.

Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with developments in eDiscovery technology and best practices.

Hybrid working
- We adopt a hybrid and flexible working approach, dependent on the requirements of the role and subject to manager approval.

Patria
on työpaikka, jossa rakennat yhteistä turvallisuutta. Meillä tavalliset ihmiset ratkaisevat epätavallisia haasteita. Kun on kyse kriittisistä operaatioista maalla, merellä, ilmassa ja verkossa, osaamisella on merkitystä. Laatu syntyy ihmisistä – jokaisesta meistä. Patriassa sinä ratkaiset.

Patrian toimintamaita ovat Suomi, Ruotsi, Norja, Latvia, Belgia, Alankomaat, Saksa, Puola, Slovakia ja Japani. Lue lisää www.patriagroup.com.

Defence and Weapon Systems
vastaa muun muassa asejärjestelmien, ilmavalvontaan liittyvien tuotteiden ja droonien myynnistä, tarjonnasta ja toimituksista.

Toimintamme kasvaessa haemme nyt joukkoomme henkilöä nimikkeellä

asejärjestelmäprojekteihin Tampereelle

Tässä roolissa työskentelet asejärjestelmäprojekteissa, johdat toimitus- ja asiakasprojekteja, sekä mahdollisesti osallistut tuotekehitys- ja tutkimusprojekteihin.

Johdat toimitusprojekteja ja vastaat niiden etenemisestä tavoitteiden mukaisesti. Osallistut myös aktiivisesti projektien tarjousvalmisteluihin.
Varmistat hankkeen suunnittelun, aikataulujen ja taloudellisten tavoitteiden saavuttamisen yhdessä projektitiimin kanssa.
Varmistat laajamittaisten toimintojen sujuvuuden.
Valvot teknisiä kokonaisuuksia ylätasolla ja toimit viestinviejänä eri sidosryhmien välillä, kuten myynti, markkinointi, hankinta, tuotehallinta, suunnittelu, tuotanto ja johto.
Varmistat projektin etenemisen, aikataulutuksen, budjetoinnin, ennustamisen, riskienhallinnan sekä raportoinnin ylemmälle tasolle ja asiakkaille.
Toimit kansainvälisissä projekteissa projektinjohtotehtävissä

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

Etsimme asiakaslähtöistä ja yhteistyökykyistä projektinhallinnan ammattilaista, jolla on valmiudet ymmärtää laajasti teknistä kokonaiskuvaa ja eri alojen toimintaa. Olet hankkinut jo työelämässä vahvaa projektihallinnan osaamista, sekä pystyt ottamaan vastuuta kansainvälisistä projekteista.

Toivomme sinulta/että sinulla on

Tekninen koulutus (Insinööri/DI).
>10 vuotta kokemusta projektipäällikön tehtävistä kansainvälisissä hankkeissa.
Sujuvaa kirjallista ja suullista viestintää suomeksi ja englanniksi.
Tehokasta projektinhallintatyökalujen käytön hallintaa.
Kykyä kommunikoida selkeästi eri sidosryhmien välillä, sekä toimia aktiivisesti asiakasrajapinnassa.
Mukautuvuutta ja ratkaisukeskeistä otetta.
Hyvää paineensietokykyä ja itseohjautuvuutta.
IPMA-sertifiointi tai vastaava projektinhallinnan sertifikaatti katsotaan eduksesi.
Kokemus puolustusteollisuuden parissa toimimisesta katsotaan eduksesi.

Meillä Patriassa pääset tekemään sellaista, mitä muualla et pääse edes näkemään. Sinulla on mahdollisuus pitkään ja monipuoliseen työuraan Patrian ainutlaatuisten tuotteiden ja toimintojen parissa. Pääset mukaan osaksi hyvähenkistä kokeneista ammattilaista koostuvaa tiimiämme.

Tarjoamme sinulle henkilöstöetuna mm. vuosittaisen tulospalkkiomallin sekä lounas- ja virike-edun ja työhön liittyvän opiskelun tukemista. Meillä on kattavat työterveyspalvelut, joihin sisältyy esim. erikoislääkäripalvelut. Tarjoamme myös vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen työntekijöillemme.

Arvostamme myös vapaa-aikaasi, joten meillä pystyt tasapainottamaan työn ja vapaa-ajan joustavasti esimerkiksi hyödyntämällä liukuvaa työaikaa. Pääset tutustumaan tarkemmin patrialaisiin ja meillä työskentelyyn täältä.

Haluaisitko olla osa tarinaamme?

Voit jättää hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta. Haethan tehtävää 20.10.2026
mennessä. Huomiothan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Jenni Autio, 13.10. klo 16-17 ja 15.10. klo 16-17.

📞 +358 50336 9468
📧 ext-jenni.autio@patriagroup.com

Käsittelemme tietojasi luottamuksellisesti. Paikkaan valitulle henkilölle tehdään perusmuotoinen turvallisuusselvitys ja huumausainetesti.

Miksi Patria?

1. Turvaa yhteiskunnalle:
edistämme ylpeydellä kansallista ja kansainvälistä turvallisuutta. Siihen tarvitaan vastuullista asennetta ja huippuosaamista, joka takaa toimintavarmuuden kaikissa olosuhteissa.

2. Sinä vaikutat:
Patriassa sinä vaikutat työsi sisältöön, urasi kehittymiseen, asiakkaidesi ja koko yrityksen menestykseen. Meillä voit olla juuri niin hyvä kuin ikinä voit olla.

3. Keskity tärkeimpään:
tee sitä, mitä rakastat ja näe kättesi jäljet. Olet meille ratkaisevan tärkeä. Haluamme että voit hyvin ja elät töiden ohella täyttä elämää.

jobs.title: AI Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
Role Overview
This role focuses on turning complex technical opportunities into practical, reliable solutions that work in real operating environments. You will partner with organisations to understand their needs, shape implementation approaches and guide solutions from initial assessment through testing, launch and ongoing improvement.
Working across business stakeholders and technical specialists, you will connect operational objectives with technical execution. You will help teams establish clear priorities, define achievable outcomes and resolve the practical challenges that arise when introducing new technology into established processes and systems.
This is a hands-on, delivery-oriented position suited to someone who combines structured problem-solving with technical fluency, sound judgement and a strong sense of accountability.
What You Will Be Responsible For
Understand the problem and shape the approach
Work directly with stakeholders to understand existing processes, technical environments, operational challenges and desired outcomes.
Identify opportunities where new technology can address meaningful problems or improve existing ways of working.
Clarify requirements, constraints, dependencies and acceptance criteria before implementation begins.
Convert broad objectives and evolving requirements into well-defined scopes of work and practical delivery plans.

Guide technical implementation
Establish implementation priorities, delivery milestones, measures of success and integration requirements.
Translate business needs into actionable guidance for engineering and other technical contributors.
Coordinate implementation activities across technical teams and stakeholder groups, maintaining alignment on priorities, decisions and expected outcomes.
Assess dependencies, surface delivery risks early, resolve obstacles and adapt plans as requirements or circumstances change.
Help ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible and appropriate for the environments in which they will operate.

Support launch and continued performance
Guide solutions through validation, readiness assessment, deployment and transition into live use.
Work with stakeholders to address issues that emerge during implementation and ensure the resulting solution meets its intended objectives.
Evaluate how deployed capabilities perform in practice, using feedback and observed usage to identify areas for refinement.
Coordinate follow-up improvements and help establish a clear path from initial implementation to sustained operational value.
Recognise further opportunities to apply successful approaches to related business needs.

Build effective working relationships
Develop a detailed understanding of stakeholder priorities by working closely with them, including through in-person collaboration when required.
Communicate technical considerations, trade-offs and delivery decisions clearly to audiences with different levels of technical expertise.
Maintain shared understanding across business and technical participants, particularly when requirements are uncertain or competing priorities arise.
Take responsibility for progress from initial problem definition through to implementation and follow-through.

What You Will Bring
Essential experience and capabilities
Experience in a technical delivery, implementation, solutions, consulting or similarly execution-focused role.
The ability to break down ambiguous problems, establish priorities and develop clear, achievable plans.
Working knowledge of software systems and technical integration concepts, including APIs, data movement and interactions between connected services.
The ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams while maintaining a clear focus on business needs and delivery outcomes.

jobs.title: Visual & Data Analyst
jobs.description:
SHEGA · WE’RE HIRING

Visual & Data Analyst

Knowledge & Intelligence · Addis Ababa · Full-time, Permanent, On-site 

The Role

We are hiring a Visual & Data Analyst to turn Shega’s data into work that people can read at a glance and act on. The role sits in the Knowledge & Intelligence unit and has one core mandate: to analyze data, identify the insights that matter, and communicate them through strong, accurate visuals. That means cleaning, structuring, and analyzing data from surveys, primary research, and secondary sources; finding the pattern that matters rather than the one that is easiest to chart; and designing the charts, infographics, and dashboards that carry Shega’s intelligence to a senior institutional audience. Report layout and social adaptations are part of the job, but they support this core work rather than define it. This is a hands-on role . You will query, analyze, and design, with every published output checked by a second reviewer before releasing, while helping set the data and visual standard that the rest of the unit works to. You will also work closely with Shega’s product team on Shega Insights, our intelligence platform, so that charts, indicator definitions, and visual presentation are consistent and reusable .  

It suits someone analytically rigorous and visually literate; comfortable moving between a messy spreadsheet, a statistical summary, and a layout file in the same week; who can take a dense, evidence-heavy body of work and make it clear, accurate, and well-designed without losing the nuance, and who treats every chart as an argument that has to hold up under scrutiny. Curiosity, passion, and the ability to work well with teams are critical for the role. We are looking for someone who is an AI-native. It is comfortable using AI tools every day to work faster and better, and disciplined about checking what those tools produce.  

Role Snapshot

Unit

Knowledge & Intelligence 
Team

Research, Data & Insight 
Reports to

Unit Lead – Knowledge & Intelligence 
Location

Addis Ababa · On-site 
Employment

Full-time · Permanent 
Application deadline

Rolling; open until filled 

What You’ll Own: Primary Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insight

Clean, structure, and validate datasets from surveys, primary research, administrative sources, and third-party databases, documenting methods so that every figure Shega publishes can be traced and defended.  
Analyze data to answer defined research questions: descriptive and comparative analysis, trend and segmentation work, and basic statistical testing, with a clear statement of what the data can and cannot support.  
Build and maintain analysis of workflows: reusable queries and scripts, standard templates, AI-assisted and automated steps where they are reliable, and a documented data library that makes the next project faster than the last.  
Own the analysis and refresh of Shega’s recurring indicator sets and reference datasets: updating them on schedule, documenting indicator definitions, and flagging breaks in the series. Source data pipelines and storage are maintained with the data team, and indicator definitions are agreed with researchers .  
Turn findings into written insight: a short, plain narrative beside each visual that says what the numbers mean for the reader’s decision.  
Use AI tools responsibly across data cleaning, analysis, coding, and visual production, while independently checking calculations, sources, and conclusions before anything is shared or published.  
Turn repeatable analysis and reporting tasks into documented, reusable workflows and automations, so outputs are reliable, and the next cycle takes less effort.  

Visual Design & Communication

Design charts, infographics, and data visuals for reports, briefs, presentations, social, and the website; accurate first, attractive second, and legible at the size they will actually be read.  
Own the analysis and visual design of dashboards for internal use and client delivery: the metrics, indicato r definitions, layout, and refresh checks. Platform integration , infrastructure, and access management sit with Product & Engineering, who you will work with closely .  
Maintain and extend the visual system for data: reusable chart templates, colour palettes, icon sets, and style guidance that others can use without you.  
Act as second reviewer on visual output from others in the unit, checking it against the accuracy and brand standard before it goes out.  

Quality, Process & Collaboration

Check the source, calculation, labelling, and caveats on every figure you produce, and make sure each published output is signed off by a second reviewer (a researcher or the Unit Lead) before release.  
Take requests from researchers, editors, and the Marketing & Growth unit from rough idea to finished visual, on deadline and with clear version control.  
Manage a visual production pipeline: requests, priorities, versions, and file organisation, so that deliverables land on time and can be found later.  
Manage tight deadlines and multiple projects simultaneously with effective prioritisationprioritization .  

Shega Insights, Data & Product Collaboration

Work with Shega’s product team on Shega Insights to develop reusable charts, consistent indicator definitions, and clear visual presentation of intelligence on the platform.  
Contribute to Ask Shega by validating its analytical outputs and making findings clear and accurate, with priorities agreed between Knowledge & Intelligence and the product team.  
Work with researchers, the data team, and Product & Engineering on dashboards and recurring datasets: you own the analysis, definitions, and visual design; they own source data pipelines, platform integration, infrastructure, and access management.  

Occasional Support

Support researchers on survey design and data collection: instrument structure, coding frames, sampling checks, and quality control on incoming data.  
Support the layout of flagship reports and client deliverables (typography, grid, colour, and page structure) applied consistently to the Shega brand.  
Produce web-ready and social-ready adaptations of key findings, including short-form graphics, carousels, and simple motion where useful, working with Marketing & Growth on distribution.  
Share analysis and design practice with junior team members so that routine visuals can run without you.  

What We’re Looking For

Essential

Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Information Systems, Graphic Design, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field.  
2–5 years’ experience combining data analysis with visual or graphic design work, with demonstrable ownership of both; not one with passing exposure to the other. An equivalent demonstrable portfolio is also acceptable.  
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, and working proficiency in at least one analysis tool such as SQL, Python, or R; comfortable cleaning and reshaping messy data.  
Hands-on experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or an equivalent tool.  
Professional design capability in Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, or Figma; able to deliver both print-ready and screen-ready work.  
Solid grounding in data visualization principles: choosing the right chart, handling scale and uncertainty honestly, and for designing accessibility.  
A portfolio of 2–3 relevant examples that shows both sides of the role , where you analyzed the data and designed the output, with a clear explanation of your own contribution to each.  
Comfortable explaining your analysis and design choices to non-technical colleagues and clients; confident in the room, not just on the page.  
Strong written English; professional working Amharic.  
Organized and self-directed. You keep several workstreams moving to deadlines without being chased.  
AI-native and comfortable with it: practical, everyday use of AI tools for data cleaning, analysis, coding, and visual production, with the discipline to independently check calculations, sources, and conclusions, and a focus on reliable outputs and reusable workflows.  

Desirable

Familiarity with Ethiopia’s digital economy, financial services, or development ecosystem.  
Experience with survey data and collection tools such as Kobo Toolbox, ODK, SurveyCTO, SPSS, or Stata.  
Interactive web visualization skills; Flourish, Datawrapper, D3, or basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.  
Motion graphics or video editing capability (After Effects, Premiere) for data-led short-form content.  
GIS and mapping experience (QGIS or similar) for geospatial analysis and map design.  
Prior work with development organizations, DFIs, research firms, or consultancies.  
Experience working with product or engineering teams on data platforms, indicator frameworks, or reusable chart libraries.  
Experience automating recurring reporting or analysis of workflows, for example with scripts, scheduled refreshes, or AI-assisted pipelines.  

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter (no more than one page) to HR@Shega.org
with the subject line “Application; Visual & Data Analyst” . In your cover letter, tell us briefly why this role, why Shega, and link to 2–3 relevant pieces of work where you did both the analysis and the design. For each, explain your specific contribution, what the data said, and what you chose to show.  
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the role is filled. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a practical assessment followed by interviews. The assessment asks you to clean a small dataset, identify the main finding, produce a visual, and write a short interpretation with sources and caveats.  

Shega is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.

This role will evaluate investment managers, strategies, performance, market trends, and portfolio considerations to develop insights and recommendations that support investment selection, portfolio construction, and allocation decisions.

In this role you will perform both qualitative and quantitative investment analysis, including evaluation of manager organizations, investment strategies, track records, portfolio construction, risk factors, and relative performance. The role will synthesize financial, market, and manager information into investment research, analytics, and recommendations for consideration by the Investment team.

In addition to manager research, you will conduct research on asset classes, industries, companies, and macroeconomic trends relevant to alternative investment strategies and portfolio positioning. This role will also contribute to the continued development of the team's research capabilities through improved analytical tools, data management, AI-enabled workflows, and other technology solutions.

Research asset classes, market trends, industries, and macroeconomic developments and assess their implications for alternative investment strategies.

Experience conducting qualitative and quantitative investment research, due diligence, financial analysis, and/or performance evaluation.
Knowledge of capital markets and investment principles, with demonstrated experience analyzing complex financial and investment information.

About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .

Role Summary

As a Senior Threat Analyst on our Managed Detection and Response (MDR) team, you will provide best-in-class monitoring, detection, and response services to proactively defend customer environments before attacks prevail. You will work alongside and contribute to a team of cyber threat hunters, incident response analysts, engineers, and ethical hackers by using enterprise, log analysis and endpoint collection systems to facilitate investigations, identification, and neutralization of cyber threats.

What You Will Do

Monitor, investigate, and respond to alerts generated by the Sophos security stack (including EDR/XDR capabilities)
Act as the escalation point for Tier I and Tier II Analysts, leading complex and high-severity investigations through to resolution
Lead the technical response to major security incidents, coordinating containment and remediation activities with customers and internal teams
Mentor and coach Tier I and Tier II Analysts, and quality-review case work to ensure thorough and accurate investigation practices
Perform end-to-end analysis on suspicious activity to assess scope, impact, and risk
Identify and respond to cyber threats across customer environments using approved playbooks and tooling
Accurately document findings, investigative steps, and outcomes in the MDR case management platform
Plan and lead hypothesis-driven threat hunts across the MDR customer base, informed by threat intelligence and adversary behavior
Investigate phishing emails, suspicious binaries, and behavioral anomalies
Drive detection improvements by identifying recurring false positives and coverage gaps, and by authoring or refining detection logic
Stay informed on threat actor behaviors, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and Sophos threat research updates
Proactively research emerging IOCs, active exploits, and vulnerabilities to stay ahead of evolving threats
Author and maintain playbooks, knowledge base articles, and documentation, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
Participate in shift rotations and ensure timely, detailed handovers between global teams
Manage case workflows: create cases, track progress, and follow up with clients until resolution
Engage with clients in English and Japanese via chat, phone, and tickets, clearly explaining findings and recommended actions
Contribute to the development of Security Operations processes and provide feedback on tooling

What You Will Bring

5+ years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Detection and Response (MDR) environment, or cybersecurity-focused IT role
Proven experience leading incident response efforts, including containment, mitigation, and recovery during active security incidents
Strong experience with endpoint and network security tools (e.g., EDR, XDR, IDS/IPS, malware defense platforms), with the ability to validate and triage complex alerts
Hands-on threat hunting experience, with a solid understanding of attacker behavior and patterns
In-depth knowledge of adversary tactics and techniques such as obfuscation, persistence, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and defense evasion, and the ability to identify these in real-world environments
Strong working knowledge of Windows operating systems (both workstation and server), with additional experience in Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, RedHat) or macOS environments
Strong ability to analyze Windows event logs and other telemetry data
Solid understanding of network traffic analysis, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, and protocols
Experience mentoring, coaching, or reviewing the work of other analysts
Excellent troubleshooting and analytical thinking skills, with attention to detail in investigations and case documentation
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
Customer-first mindset with professionalism and a focus on service excellence
Must thrive within a team environment as well as on an individual basis
Natural curiosity and ability to learn new skills quickly in a fast-paced, ever-changing threat landscape
A proactive approach to improving detections, processes, and tooling
A passion for cybersecurity, continuous improvement, and staying current on threat trends
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Business-level Japanese (JLPT N2 or above, or native) and business-level English, both written and spoken
Willingness to participate in shift work including nights, weekends and holidays (our MDR service is 24x7x365)

Desirable

Strong knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its application in detection and response
Experience working with SIEM platforms and managing enterprise security telemetry
Ability to write and interpret SQL queries for data analysis and investigation
Experience with OSQuery
Programming and scripting skills, particularly in PowerShell
Advanced cybersecurity certifications (e.g., GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, GREM, OSCP, CISSP, or similar)

Research brands and merchants online and map transaction data to the correct entities with a high standard of accuracy.

Experience with data annotation, taxonomy building or other forms of data markup.
