The eDiscovery Project Manager will play a key role within the Firm’s Data Privacy and eDiscovery function, supporting the efficient management of electronic discovery processes, data subject rights requests, and related compliance activities.

Reporting to the Data Privacy Officer (DPO), the eDiscovery Project Manager will work with the eDiscovery Manager by providing technical support, predominantly on file reviews, transfers and data subject access requests (DSARs), as part of the Firm’s in-house compliance and regulatory requirements. In addition, the eDiscovery Project Manager may be required to assist fee-earning teams, such as Employment, Litigation and Dispute Resolution, with eDiscovery for disputes and claims.

The ideal candidate will possess knowledge of litigation, DSARs and file transfer processes, document management and access to data and data organisation, have a broad range of experience in applied technology and be able to make recommendations to improve our practices and implement the best technical and practical solutions.

Roles and Responsibilities 

Manage end-to-end eDiscovery projects across the firm, including scoping, data collection, processing, review, and production for both internal compliance matters and fee earner client work.

Partner with fee-earning teams across practice areas including Litigation, Employment, Dispute Resolution, and Corporate to deliver eDiscovery support for disputes, investigations, and transactional due diligence.

Advise stakeholders on eDiscovery best practices, technology solutions, and defensible workflows to ensure efficient and compliant handling of electronically stored information.

Support the selection, implementation, and ongoing management of eDiscovery platforms and tools, ensuring they meet the needs of both compliance and client-facing work.

Coordinate data collection and preservation activities, working with IT, Information Security, and matter teams to ensure defensibility and chain of custody.

Develop and maintain eDiscovery workflows, protocols, and quality control procedures to ensure consistency and accuracy across all projects.

Provide training and support to fee earners, paralegals, and support staff on eDiscovery processes, tools, and technology-assisted review methodologies.

Support the eDiscovery Manager, DPO and GCO team with data subject access requests (DSARs), file reviews, and other regulatory compliance matters as required.

Liaise with external eDiscovery vendors and service providers, managing relationships and ensuring cost-effective delivery of services.

Prepare and manage project budgets, timelines, and reporting, keeping stakeholders informed of progress and any issues.

Stay current with developments in eDiscovery technology, legal requirements, and industry best practices, recommending improvements to the firm’s capabilities.

Comply with all relevant legal and regulatory obligations including the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Standards and Regulations, and Principles.

Skills and Experience

Essential

Demonstrable experience in eDiscovery project management within a law firm, legal services provider, or corporate legal department.

Strong working knowledge of eDiscovery platforms and tools (e.g. Relativity, Nuix, Concordance, or similar).

Understanding of the litigation lifecycle, disclosure obligations under the Civil Procedure Rules, and data protection legislation including UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.

Experience managing data collection, processing, review, and production workflows.

Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver to deadlines.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable

Relevant professional qualification or certification in eDiscovery, project management, or information governance (e.g. ACEDS, CIPP, PRINCE2, or equivalent).

Experience with technology-assisted review (TAR), predictive coding, or AI-powered review tools.

Experience handling data subject access requests (DSARs) and regulatory investigations.

Knowledge of digital forensics principles and data preservation techniques.

Experience working with external eDiscovery vendors and managing third-party service providers.

Person Specification

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and legal concepts clearly to diverse audiences including fee earners, clients, and IT teams.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a methodical approach to managing large volumes of data and identifying efficient solutions.

Highly organised with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when working under pressure or to tight deadlines.

Adaptable and resilient, able to respond effectively to changing priorities and manage competing demands across multiple projects.

Collaborative team player who builds trusted working relationships and works effectively across departments and with external providers.

Proactive and self-motivated, with the confidence to take ownership of projects and drive them through to completion.

Commercial awareness with an understanding of how eDiscovery supports client service delivery and the firm’s business objectives.

Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with developments in eDiscovery technology and best practices.

Hybrid working
- We adopt a hybrid and flexible working approach, dependent on the requirements of the role and subject to manager approval.

new_jobs.title: AI Deployment Strategist
new_jobs.description:
Role Overview
This role focuses on turning complex technical opportunities into practical, reliable solutions that work in real operating environments. You will partner with organisations to understand their needs, shape implementation approaches and guide solutions from initial assessment through testing, launch and ongoing improvement.
Working across business stakeholders and technical specialists, you will connect operational objectives with technical execution. You will help teams establish clear priorities, define achievable outcomes and resolve the practical challenges that arise when introducing new technology into established processes and systems.
This is a hands-on, delivery-oriented position suited to someone who combines structured problem-solving with technical fluency, sound judgement and a strong sense of accountability.
What You Will Be Responsible For
Understand the problem and shape the approach
Work directly with stakeholders to understand existing processes, technical environments, operational challenges and desired outcomes.
Identify opportunities where new technology can address meaningful problems or improve existing ways of working.
Clarify requirements, constraints, dependencies and acceptance criteria before implementation begins.
Convert broad objectives and evolving requirements into well-defined scopes of work and practical delivery plans.

Guide technical implementation
Establish implementation priorities, delivery milestones, measures of success and integration requirements.
Translate business needs into actionable guidance for engineering and other technical contributors.
Coordinate implementation activities across technical teams and stakeholder groups, maintaining alignment on priorities, decisions and expected outcomes.
Assess dependencies, surface delivery risks early, resolve obstacles and adapt plans as requirements or circumstances change.
Help ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible and appropriate for the environments in which they will operate.

Support launch and continued performance
Guide solutions through validation, readiness assessment, deployment and transition into live use.
Work with stakeholders to address issues that emerge during implementation and ensure the resulting solution meets its intended objectives.
Evaluate how deployed capabilities perform in practice, using feedback and observed usage to identify areas for refinement.
Coordinate follow-up improvements and help establish a clear path from initial implementation to sustained operational value.
Recognise further opportunities to apply successful approaches to related business needs.

Build effective working relationships
Develop a detailed understanding of stakeholder priorities by working closely with them, including through in-person collaboration when required.
Communicate technical considerations, trade-offs and delivery decisions clearly to audiences with different levels of technical expertise.
Maintain shared understanding across business and technical participants, particularly when requirements are uncertain or competing priorities arise.
Take responsibility for progress from initial problem definition through to implementation and follow-through.

What You Will Bring
Essential experience and capabilities
Experience in a technical delivery, implementation, solutions, consulting or similarly execution-focused role.
The ability to break down ambiguous problems, establish priorities and develop clear, achievable plans.
Working knowledge of software systems and technical integration concepts, including APIs, data movement and interactions between connected services.
The ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams while maintaining a clear focus on business needs and delivery outcomes.
Strong communication skills, with the confidence to manage expectations, align stakeholders and explain complex topics clearly.
A high degree of ownership, practical judgement and initiative, with a willingness to address problems directly rather than wait for direction.
A genuine interest in applying emerging AI capabilities to practical use cases and helping those solutions succeed beyond initial experimentation.

Additional strengths
The following would be beneficial but are not essential:
Experience in technical advisory work, solution design, implementation consulting or roles closely embedded with customers during delivery.
Practical software development or engineering experience.
Involvement in taking software or technology solutions into production and supporting them after launch.
Experience working in an environment where priorities evolve quickly and individuals are expected to operate with considerable autonomy.

How Success Will Be Measured
Success in this role will be reflected in your ability to:
Turn unclear or complex requirements into focused implementation plans.
Maintain alignment between stakeholder expectations and technical delivery.
Help teams navigate integration challenges, dependencies and implementation risks.
Support successful launches and the effective use of solutions in day-to-day operations.
Identify meaningful improvements based on practical experience and performance feedback.
Demonstrate tangible progress against agreed objectives and help uncover further opportunities to create value.

Working Style
You will work at the intersection of technical problem-solving, stakeholder collaboration and delivery execution. The work will require you to move comfortably between understanding operational needs, discussing technical approaches and coordinating the activities required to put solutions into practice.
Not every challenge will arrive with a clearly defined scope or an established process. You should be comfortable making progress with incomplete information, asking the right questions, adapting your approach and remaining accountable for outcomes.
The role involves direct engagement with external stakeholders and may require time spent at their workplaces to understand operational realities and support implementation.
The Opportunity
This position offers the opportunity to work on practical applications of emerging technology, contribute to complex implementation efforts and see the results of your work in live environments.
You will collaborate with technically capable colleagues and stakeholders across different functions, solving problems that require both analytical thinking and effective execution. The emphasis is on moving beyond concepts and prototypes to deliver solutions that are useful, adopted and capable of producing measurable improvements.

new_jobs.title: Visual & Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
SHEGA · WE’RE HIRING

Visual & Data Analyst

Knowledge & Intelligence · Addis Ababa · Full-time, Permanent, On-site 

The Role

We are hiring a Visual & Data Analyst to turn Shega’s data into work that people can read at a glance and act on. The role sits in the Knowledge & Intelligence unit and has one core mandate: to analyze data, identify the insights that matter, and communicate them through strong, accurate visuals. That means cleaning, structuring, and analyzing data from surveys, primary research, and secondary sources; finding the pattern that matters rather than the one that is easiest to chart; and designing the charts, infographics, and dashboards that carry Shega’s intelligence to a senior institutional audience. Report layout and social adaptations are part of the job, but they support this core work rather than define it. This is a hands-on role . You will query, analyze, and design, with every published output checked by a second reviewer before releasing, while helping set the data and visual standard that the rest of the unit works to. You will also work closely with Shega’s product team on Shega Insights, our intelligence platform, so that charts, indicator definitions, and visual presentation are consistent and reusable .  

It suits someone analytically rigorous and visually literate; comfortable moving between a messy spreadsheet, a statistical summary, and a layout file in the same week; who can take a dense, evidence-heavy body of work and make it clear, accurate, and well-designed without losing the nuance, and who treats every chart as an argument that has to hold up under scrutiny. Curiosity, passion, and the ability to work well with teams are critical for the role. We are looking for someone who is an AI-native. It is comfortable using AI tools every day to work faster and better, and disciplined about checking what those tools produce.  

Role Snapshot

Unit

Knowledge & Intelligence 
Team

Research, Data & Insight 
Reports to

Unit Lead – Knowledge & Intelligence 
Location

Addis Ababa · On-site 
Employment

Full-time · Permanent 
Application deadline

Rolling; open until filled 

What You’ll Own: Primary Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insight

Clean, structure, and validate datasets from surveys, primary research, administrative sources, and third-party databases, documenting methods so that every figure Shega publishes can be traced and defended.  
Analyze data to answer defined research questions: descriptive and comparative analysis, trend and segmentation work, and basic statistical testing, with a clear statement of what the data can and cannot support.  
Build and maintain analysis of workflows: reusable queries and scripts, standard templates, AI-assisted and automated steps where they are reliable, and a documented data library that makes the next project faster than the last.  
Own the analysis and refresh of Shega’s recurring indicator sets and reference datasets: updating them on schedule, documenting indicator definitions, and flagging breaks in the series. Source data pipelines and storage are maintained with the data team, and indicator definitions are agreed with researchers .  
Turn findings into written insight: a short, plain narrative beside each visual that says what the numbers mean for the reader’s decision.  
Use AI tools responsibly across data cleaning, analysis, coding, and visual production, while independently checking calculations, sources, and conclusions before anything is shared or published.  
Turn repeatable analysis and reporting tasks into documented, reusable workflows and automations, so outputs are reliable, and the next cycle takes less effort.  

Visual Design & Communication

Design charts, infographics, and data visuals for reports, briefs, presentations, social, and the website; accurate first, attractive second, and legible at the size they will actually be read.  
Own the analysis and visual design of dashboards for internal use and client delivery: the metrics, indicato r definitions, layout, and refresh checks. Platform integration , infrastructure, and access management sit with Product & Engineering, who you will work with closely .  
Maintain and extend the visual system for data: reusable chart templates, colour palettes, icon sets, and style guidance that others can use without you.  
Act as second reviewer on visual output from others in the unit, checking it against the accuracy and brand standard before it goes out.  

Quality, Process & Collaboration

Check the source, calculation, labelling, and caveats on every figure you produce, and make sure each published output is signed off by a second reviewer (a researcher or the Unit Lead) before release.  
Take requests from researchers, editors, and the Marketing & Growth unit from rough idea to finished visual, on deadline and with clear version control.  
Manage a visual production pipeline: requests, priorities, versions, and file organisation, so that deliverables land on time and can be found later.  
Manage tight deadlines and multiple projects simultaneously with effective prioritisationprioritization .  

Shega Insights, Data & Product Collaboration

Work with Shega’s product team on Shega Insights to develop reusable charts, consistent indicator definitions, and clear visual presentation of intelligence on the platform.  
Contribute to Ask Shega by validating its analytical outputs and making findings clear and accurate, with priorities agreed between Knowledge & Intelligence and the product team.  
Work with researchers, the data team, and Product & Engineering on dashboards and recurring datasets: you own the analysis, definitions, and visual design; they own source data pipelines, platform integration, infrastructure, and access management.  

Occasional Support

Support researchers on survey design and data collection: instrument structure, coding frames, sampling checks, and quality control on incoming data.  
Support the layout of flagship reports and client deliverables (typography, grid, colour, and page structure) applied consistently to the Shega brand.  
Produce web-ready and social-ready adaptations of key findings, including short-form graphics, carousels, and simple motion where useful, working with Marketing & Growth on distribution.  
Share analysis and design practice with junior team members so that routine visuals can run without you.  

What We’re Looking For

Essential

Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Information Systems, Graphic Design, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field.  
2–5 years’ experience combining data analysis with visual or graphic design work, with demonstrable ownership of both; not one with passing exposure to the other. An equivalent demonstrable portfolio is also acceptable.  
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, and working proficiency in at least one analysis tool such as SQL, Python, or R; comfortable cleaning and reshaping messy data.  
Hands-on experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or an equivalent tool.  
Professional design capability in Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, or Figma; able to deliver both print-ready and screen-ready work.  
Solid grounding in data visualization principles: choosing the right chart, handling scale and uncertainty honestly, and for designing accessibility.  
A portfolio of 2–3 relevant examples that shows both sides of the role , where you analyzed the data and designed the output, with a clear explanation of your own contribution to each.  
Comfortable explaining your analysis and design choices to non-technical colleagues and clients; confident in the room, not just on the page.  
Strong written English; professional working Amharic.  
Organized and self-directed. You keep several workstreams moving to deadlines without being chased.  
AI-native and comfortable with it: practical, everyday use of AI tools for data cleaning, analysis, coding, and visual production, with the discipline to independently check calculations, sources, and conclusions, and a focus on reliable outputs and reusable workflows.  

Desirable

Familiarity with Ethiopia’s digital economy, financial services, or development ecosystem.  
Experience with survey data and collection tools such as Kobo Toolbox, ODK, SurveyCTO, SPSS, or Stata.  
Interactive web visualization skills; Flourish, Datawrapper, D3, or basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.  
Motion graphics or video editing capability (After Effects, Premiere) for data-led short-form content.  
GIS and mapping experience (QGIS or similar) for geospatial analysis and map design.  
Prior work with development organizations, DFIs, research firms, or consultancies.  
Experience working with product or engineering teams on data platforms, indicator frameworks, or reusable chart libraries.  
Experience automating recurring reporting or analysis of workflows, for example with scripts, scheduled refreshes, or AI-assisted pipelines.  

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter (no more than one page) to HR@Shega.org
with the subject line “Application; Visual & Data Analyst” . In your cover letter, tell us briefly why this role, why Shega, and link to 2–3 relevant pieces of work where you did both the analysis and the design. For each, explain your specific contribution, what the data said, and what you chose to show.  
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the role is filled. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a practical assessment followed by interviews. The assessment asks you to clean a small dataset, identify the main finding, produce a visual, and write a short interpretation with sources and caveats.  

Shega is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.  

Shega · HR@Shega.org · www.shega.co

Solid understanding of network traffic analysis, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, and protocols

Customer-first mindset with professionalism and a focus on service excellence

Natural curiosity and ability to learn new skills quickly in a fast-paced, ever-changing threat landscape

You will analyse US consumer credit card spend data, research and classify brands and merchants, and map them accurately to create insights and analytical reports. Alongside that analytical work, you will spend a significant part of your time building and maintaining the pipelines that move and shape that data, working with senior data engineers, data scientists and analysts to turn raw transaction data into reliable, analysis-ready datasets.

The ideal candidate combines a genuinely critical eye for data with strong Python and SQL skills, curiosity about cloud data infrastructure, and comfort with modern development practices including AI-assisted coding and version control. You will be given real ownership early and supported by an experienced team.

Location
: Kolkata (Rajarhat, New Town)

Experience Level
: 1-3 years

Ability to work in the US Eastern time zone. This may be relaxed to half day IST and half day US EST, based on project needs.

Consumer spend research and analysis

Analyse US consumer credit card spend data, identifying patterns, anomalies and variations that are not obvious at first glance.
Research brands and merchants online and map transaction data to the correct entities with a high standard of accuracy.
Conduct online research across search engines, directories and unconventional sources to resolve ambiguous or incomplete records.
Produce clear, well-written analytical reports and insight summaries for client-side stakeholders.
Perform exploratory analysis to investigate data discrepancies, identify trends and support decision-making by product and business teams.

Data engineering and pipeline work

Build and maintain ETL and ELT scripts and data transformation logic in Python and SQL, under the guidance of senior engineers.
Write clean, tested, well-documented Python for data ingestion, cleaning, validation and enrichment across multiple source systems.
Support the development and monitoring of data workflows orchestrated with Apache Airflow, including troubleshooting failed runs.
Work with AWS data services including S3, Glue, Athena and Redshift to move, store and query data at scale.
Write and optimise complex SQL queries, and use regular expressions to filter, classify and clean large volumes of transaction data.
Implement and run data quality checks, reconciliation routines and alerting so issues are caught before they reach downstream consume

Ways of working

Use AI-powered coding assistants and IDE integrations such as Kiro to accelerate development, code review and documentation.
Follow version control and code review practices using Git.
Apply data governance, security and access-control standards consistently across all work.
Document pipelines, data definitions, classification rules and analysis methods so the team can rely on and extend your work.

‍

Required Qualifications

Graduate in any discipline. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics or a related field is preferred, as is exposure to market research or data analytics.
1 to 3 years of professional experience in data analysis, data engineering, market research or a closely related role.
Strong proficiency in Python for data work, including pandas, and the ability to write production-quality scripts rather than notebook-only code.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, window functions, aggregations and query optimisation.
Working knowledge of regular expressions for pattern matching and data classification. This is mandatory.
Working exposure to AWS, covering services such as S3, Glue, Athena and Redshift.
Understanding of ETL and ELT concepts, data modelling fundamentals and relational database design.
Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Demonstrated ability to use AI-assisted development tools within modern IDEs for prototyping, code generation, testing and debugging.
Software literacy: able to learn new programs quickly and comfortable navigating unfamiliar interfaces and expressions.
A critical eye: able to think laterally to find sources of information that help distinguish variations in data that look identical at first glance.
Online research capability: comfortable navigating web pages, search engines, directories and unconventional sources.
Excellent reading and writing: can process and produce long or complex alphanumeric strings, both abstract and functional, with ease and accuracy.
Excellent communication: can clearly explain how and why decisions were made, and can take and act on constructive feedback.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
Good written and spoken English, with the confidence to work directly with client-side stakeholders.

‍

Good To Have

Hands-on exposure to Apache Airflow or a comparable orchestration tool.
Experience with data annotation, taxonomy building or other forms of data markup.
Exposure to machine learning or LLM workflows, or to supporting data scientists with feature preparation.
Prior experience working with US market data or financial transaction data.
Residence within one hour of travel to the office.

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
ABOUT Jotform

Jotform is a San Francisco-based SaaS company with more than 35 million users worldwide. We are thriving and growing and we’ve never needed outside funding. That’s because we like keeping things agile, independent and fun. Jotform believes everyone should be able to create their own online forms. Our 10,000+ ready-made form templates, 100+ integrations and more than 380 widgets have made us one of the most popular online form builders for organizations of all sizes — from small businesses to enterprises.

Since our inception in 2006, our mission has been to help users create, manage and share online forms and receive responses in the easiest way possible.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Jotform is seeking Senior
Data Analysts
in our Ankara office, located at a relaxed fun environment in ODTU Teknokent. As a rapidly growing company we are hiring for similar positions continuously and once an opportunity matches with your qualifications, we will contact you immediately.

Here’s what you will be doing:

Work with product management and product teams, extract, interpret and present insights from data to support their decisions
Enable visibility into historical data and provide the ability to identify the root causes of change
Design A/B test, interpret and present the findings to support business decisions
Assist development teams with reports and metrics that will present actionable insights
Create, implement and improve statistical algorithms to help generate forecasts and predictive recommendations
Create insightful data visualizations and turn statistical and computational analysis into user-friendly graphs, charts and animations
Collaborate with Growth Team to develop tools and services such as modeling dashboard to drive innovation and recommend solutions

Education & Work Experience & Technical Requirements:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Math, Economics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics or related quantitative field
At least 5 years of experience in quantitative analytics or data modeling
Strong Knowledge in SQL
Ability to extract, interpret and present insights from unstructured and structured data
Understanding of relevant statistical measures such as confidence intervals, significance of error measurements, development and evaluation data sets
Track record of diving into data to discover hidden patterns
Experience in sales analytics, client retention analytics and customer analytics are highly preferred
Prior internships or experience in statistics and data mining is a plus
Excellent communications and presentation skills in English

Personal Specifications/Skills:

Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a concise and actionable manner
Passionate about technology
Eager to learn and stretch boundaries
Seeks new approaches and new ideas
Critical thinker & curious learner

Jotform PERKS

High growth-paced environment with collaborative and unique team culture
Generous market competitive total compensation package
Health Insurance
Professional Growth & Career Opportunities: We support your personal and professional development with educational materials and expenses & relevant conferences abroad to stay up to date with the latest industry trends & online courses or coaching - and support you pursuing ones that you are passionate about!
Challenging projects, regular feedback, healthy competition
Fun & Relax working environment: When we’re in the office; music, jeans and t-shirts are the norm & kitchens stocked with healthy & tasty snacks & drinks

OUR PROCESS

We’ll review your application along with all the others we receive and pick the top profiles for a screening call. In many cases due to time constraints and our candidate volume, only the short-listed candidates are contacted but we do consider each application carefully. If you have been selected as a short-listed candidate we will contact you for a short screening call to get to know you better. If you don’t get a call please don’t be disappointed! We receive many applications for each role and have to prioritize who we speak to.

Thank you for taking the time to apply for a position at Jotform!

Jotform is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst (m/w/d) – Industrial & Automotive Consulting
new_jobs.description:
Beschreibung

Du willst im Bereich Data Science & Analytics dort arbeiten, wo es wirklich zählt – an komplexen Industrieprojekten mit direktem Einfluss auf Entscheidungen auf Management-Ebene?

Bei DRIVE Consulting arbeitest du an anspruchsvollen Fragestellungen führender Industrieunternehmen. Du unterstützt dabei, datengetriebene Entscheidungen in Transformations- und Beratungsprojekten umzusetzen. Unsere Analysen und Dashboards fließen direkt in das Reporting und die Entscheidungsgrundlagen unserer Kunden ein.

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du hands-on an Analytics-Lösungen und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Dashboards, der Analyse komplexer Daten sowie beim Aufbau von Datenstrukturen und -pipelines. Dabei begleitest du Projekte von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und entwickelst deine fachlichen und methodischen Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich weiter.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest an Analytics-Workstreams in Kundenprojekten und übernimmst Verantwortung für eigene Aufgaben und Teilprojekte
Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst und betreibst du Datenpipelines zwischen Cloud-Quellen und Analytics- bzw. Dashboard-Tools und stellst deren Qualität, Automatisierung und Performance sicher (insbesondere über SQL)
Du konzipierst und entwickelst Dashboards mit Fokus auf Usability und klare Entscheidungsunterstützung für das Management
Du analysierst komplexe und heterogene Datenstrukturen, bereitest Daten auf und führst verschiedene Datenquellen effizient zusammen
Du führst Ad-hoc-Analysen und explorative Auswertungen durch und bereitest Ergebnisse adressatengerecht auf
Du arbeitest eng im Projektteam und mit relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen und treibst die Umsetzung datengetriebener Lösungen aktiv voran
Du unterstützt bei Architekturfragen, Priorisierungen und der Weiterentwicklung von Analytics-Lösungen
Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst dich fachlich und methodisch kontinuierlich weiter

Dein Profil

Du hast erste Berufserfahrung (ca. 1–3 Jahre) im Bereich Data Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Umfeld
Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Python und bist in der Lage, komplexe Datenstrukturen eigenständig zu analysieren und aufzubereiten
Du hast erste Erfahrung im Aufbau von Datenpipelines und/oder im Dashboarding gesammelt
Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit BI-Tools (z. B. AWS QuickSight, Grafana, Tableau, etc.) mit
Du arbeitest analytisch und strukturiert und hast Freude daran, komplexe Fragestellungen zu lösen
Du denkst dich schnell in neue Themen ein und entwickelst dich fachlich kontinuierlich weiter
Idealerweise hast du erste Berührungspunkte mit Prozessen in der Automobilindustrie oder im industriellen Umfeld
Du arbeitest gerne im Team, kommunizierst klar und trittst auch im Austausch mit Kunden sicher auf
Du bist bereit, regelmäßig vor Ort bei unseren Kunden zu arbeiten

Unser Angebot an dich

Bei DRIVE Consulting triffst du auf ein junges, wachsendes Team, dessen Herz für technische Beratungsprojekte in der Industrie schlägt – insbesondere im Automotive-Umfeld.

Dich erwartet ein Umfeld mit hohem fachlichen Anspruch, schneller Lernkurve und individueller Weiterentwicklung. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen zusammen, übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Themen und entwickelst deine fachlichen und methodischen Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich weiter.

Offenheit, Vertrauen und Teamspirit prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit – in einem motivierten Team mit klarer Umsetzungsorientierung.

Außerdem Erwarten Dich

Individuelles Coaching und persönliches Buddy-Programm für deinen Einstieg und deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung
Dienstwagen oder Jobrad bzw. Jobticket – flexibel nach deinen Bedürfnissen
Täglicher Lunch-Zuschuss (6 €)
EGYM Wellpass für Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote
Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte über Corporate Benefits
Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
Obst, Kaffee und Erfrischungsgetränke im Office
Regelmäßige Teamevents zur Stärkung des Teamzusammenhalts
Monatliches Happy Friday Frühstück
100 € Spendenbudget zur freien Verfügung
Sabbatical-Optionen

Über uns

DRIVE Consulting GmbH
ist eine Unternehmensberatung mit Hauptsitz in Aachen sowie Standorten in München, Berlin, Peking und Shanghai. Unser Herz schlägt für technische Beratungsprojekte mit Fokus auf die Automobil- und Industriebranche. Zu unseren Kunden zählen sowohl deutsche Premium OEMs als auch junge, aufstrebende Automobilhersteller sowie große und mittelständische Industrieunternehmen.

Unser Name steht für unseren klaren Fokus auf die Mobilitätsbranche und repräsentiert gleichzeitig unseren Spirit – denn wir sind ein Team, in dem jede*r Einzelne DRIVE hat.

Wir stehen unseren Kunden als Wegbereiter ins Unbekannte und als Katalysator für Innovationen zur Seite. Denn wir sind überzeugt, dass man nur mit dem Mut, neue Wege einzuschlagen, einzigartige Erfolgsgeschichten schreiben kann.

Wir schlagen Brücken zwischen kleinen Ideenschmieden und großen Konzernen sowie zwischen Management und Technologieexpert*innen.

Durch den engen und partnerschaftlichen Austausch mit unseren Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte und individuelle Lösungen. Ein entscheidender Erfolgsfaktor ist dabei unser einzigartiges Partnernetzwerk aus Industrie und Forschung. Dank unserer Nähe zu namhaften Universitäten wie der RWTH Aachen verbinden wir Wissenschaft und Praxis.

Begeisterung wird bei uns großgeschrieben
und bestimmt unseren Arbeitsalltag – denn sie ist der beste Antrieb.

new_jobs.description:
Archimedes

About Us

Archimedes - Transforming the Specialty Drug Benefit - Archimedes is the industry leader in specialty drug management solutions. Founded with the goal of transforming the PBM industry to provide the necessary ingredients for the sustainability of the prescription drug benefit – alignment, value and transparency – Archimedes achieves superior results for clients by eliminating tightly held PBM conflicts of interest including drug spread, rebate retention and pharmacy ownership and delivering the most rigorous clinical management at the lowest net cost. .____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________. Current associates must use SSO login option at https://employees-navitus.icims.com/ to be considered for internal opportunities.________We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees and comply with all applicable nondiscrimination regulations, including those related to protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or handicap.

Pay Range

USD $0.00 - USD $0.00 /Yr.

STAR Bonus % (At Risk Maximum)

13.50 - Manager, Clinical Mgr, Pharm Supvr, CAE, Sr CAE I

Work Schedule Description (e.g. M-F 8am To 5pm)

M-F 8am to 5pm, Remote or Hybrid- In Office 3 Days

Remote Work Notification

ATTENTION: Archimedes is only able to offer remote work to residents of Alabama, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin.

Overview

The Sr. Analyst, Data leads complex analytical initiatives and designs reliable data solutions that support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders to translate ambiguous or complex business problems into scalable analytical approaches, trusted datasets, and clear recommendations.

The Sr. Analyst, Data has deep knowledge of Archimedes business offerings, healthcare and pharmacy benefit management data, analytical workflows, and data dependencies. Leveraging advanced SQL expertise, data modeling knowledge, and strong business judgment, this role promotes best practices, improves legacy and modern reporting processes, mentors other analysts, and helps ensure that the organization makes decisions using accurate, well-understood data.

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

Lead complex, cross-functional, analytical projects from business problem definition through data analysis, validation, stakeholder communication, and final delivery.
Translate ambiguous business questions into analytical plans, reusable reporting logic, scalable datasets, and actionable recommendations.
Design, maintain, and optimize SQL-based analytical solutions, data models, views, stored procedures, and recurring reporting workflows supporting operational and strategic needs.
Write and review advanced SQL using SSMS, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, temporary tables, stored procedures, performance-aware query design, and robust validation logic.
Analyze pharmacy claims, member, client, drug, formulary, rebate, network, provider, clinical, operational, and financial datasets to identify risks, opportunities, trends, and decision points.
Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned business domains, datasets, metrics, reporting processes, and data dependencies.
Advise stakeholders on metric definitions, data interpretation, analytical trade-offs, appropriate methodology, assumptions, limitations, and recommended actions.
Develop and enhance Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and analytical deliverables used by business stakeholders and leadership.
Establish and promote practical standards for data validation, documentation, report design, quality assurance, peer review, and maintainable analytical code.
Investigate complex data quality issues, reconcile outputs across systems, identify root causes, and recommend durable process or data improvements.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a quantitative, business, healthcare, information systems, economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or related field, or equivalent work experience, required.
5 years of experience with data analysis, business analysis, analytics engineering, reporting, data warehousing, or related analytical work in a production environment required.
Advanced SQL proficiency, including window functions, stored procedures, temp tables, performance-aware query design, data validation, and troubleshooting complex business logic, required.
Experience leading complex analytical projects, translating ambiguous requirements, and delivering high-quality work with minimal managerial guidance required.
Advanced experience using SSMS and SQL Server-based analytics environments to develop, validate, document, and optimize analytical solutions required.
Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT workflows, data modeling, upstream and downstream dependencies, and production reporting controls required.
Experience developing or improving Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and governed analytical datasets required.
Ability to establish practical standards for documentation, quality assurance, peer review, maintainability, and business-rule transparency required.

What can you expect from Navitus?

Top of the industry benefits for Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
20 days paid time off
4 weeks paid parental leave
9 paid holidays
401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement
Adoption Assistance Program
Flexible Spending Account
Educational Assistance Plan and Professional Membership assistance
Referral Bonus Program – up to $750!

new_jobs.description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The ALTO project is a major infrastructure initiative in Canadian history, aimed at developing over 1,000 km of new passenger rail service between major urban centers, including Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Quebec City.

Missions/Main Duties

Manage, structure, analyze, and standardize project data to support business and user requirements.
Develop and automate data processes and optimize tools across the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem to improve efficiency and data quality.
Build and maintain dashboards, visualizations, dataflows, and semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to monitor performance and generate insights.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting needs, deliver effective solutions, and support informed decision-making.
Maintain documentation and ensure compliance with governance, security, and regulatory requirements.

Profile/Skills

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in in computer science, business intelligence, data analytics, statistics, business administration, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Years of experience:
2 to 3 years of experience in a similar role.

Technical Skills

Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Dataflow Gen2, Data Factory, and Notebooks, for data ingestion, storage, organization, transformation, and orchestration of analytics workflows.
Proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to design, maintain, and optimize semantic models, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
Strong command of DAX and Power Query for data modeling, extraction, cleansing, transformation, and advanced analytics.
Solid understanding of data modeling, data governance, and data quality principles.
Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing, in French and English*
Reasons for the bilingual requirement: You will have the opportunity to collaborate with various project stakeholders; bilingualism is essential for building strong relationships with our clients, understanding their specific needs, and communicating effectively in their preferred language.

Interpersonal Skills

Analytical mindset, rigor, and autonomy
Ability to work in an agile and collaborative environment
Strong technical communication skills.

new_jobs.title: Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Operations Analyst

A global logistics leader building its India operations-analytics team

Location:
Remote (India)
About the Company

A global logistics leader is building its India operations-analytics team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire an Operations Analyst. You will turn shipment, throughput, and SLA data into insight that keeps a high-volume network running on time. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.
Role Overview

As an Operations Analyst, you will track performance metrics and analyse operational data across the network, giving operations managers the numbers they need to act on.
Key Responsibilities

Data & Metrics Analysis

Track shipment volumes, SLA adherence, and exception rates across the network
Analyse route, capacity, and turnaround-time data to spot bottlenecks
Build recurring reports on cost-per-shipment and service-level performance

Reporting & Process Support

Build dashboards that operations managers and leadership review weekly
Document process gaps and recommend fixes, without owning execution
Support ad hoc data requests from operations and account teams

Ideal Candidate Profile

The Senior Program Manager is the core team leader and single point of program accountability for assigned Infusion Systems pump programs. Managing a team from behind a desk without regularly coaching students and Guides firsthand.
Preserving outdated practices simply because "that's how we've always done it."

new_jobs.title: Principal Information Systems Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Information Systems Project Manager based in the United States.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced IT project management professional to lead complex enterprise technology initiatives supporting critical business operations. In this role, you will oversee the delivery of enterprise resource management platforms and applications, ensuring alignment between technical solutions and business objectives. You will coordinate cross-functional teams, manage project resources, and drive initiatives from planning through deployment and operational transition. Working across IT, cybersecurity, business operations, and other stakeholder groups, you will help deliver secure, scalable, and reliable information systems. This position offers the opportunity to influence high-visibility projects, implement technology best practices, and lead organizational change. Join a collaborative, innovation-driven environment that encourages continuous learning, professional growth, and meaningful contributions to enterprise-wide digital transformation.

Accountabilities

Lead complex, high-visibility IT projects involving enterprise resource management systems, resource forecasting tools, and related business applications.
Develop comprehensive project execution plans, define objectives and deliverables, allocate resources, and establish roles and responsibilities across matrixed teams.
Manage project schedules, budgets, risks, priorities, and resource allocation to ensure delivery meets technical, security, and business requirements.
Coordinate the complete information systems delivery lifecycle, including solution design, development, cybersecurity, testing, deployment, and operational handover.
Provide project management guidance and technical direction, applying established methodologies, industry best practices, and emerging IT tools to improve execution.
Collaborate with business leaders, IT teams, security specialists, engineering groups, and external stakeholders to resolve complex technical and operational challenges.
Represent project teams in stakeholder discussions, communicate progress and risks, and facilitate decisions that support successful project outcomes.
Develop and implement change management and business readiness strategies, including stakeholder communications, training programs, and user adoption initiatives.
Support enterprise initiatives involving data migration, reporting, metrics dashboards, system testing, and deployment activities.
Identify opportunities to improve project governance, delivery processes, and enterprise technology solutions while maintaining alignment with organizational priorities.

Requirements

A bachelor's degree and at least five years of relevant professional experience, a master's degree and at least three years of experience, or a PhD and at least one year of experience. Candidates without a degree may qualify with nine years of relevant experience.
Demonstrated experience managing IT projects or programs involving multiple functional organizations, such as business operations, information technology, cybersecurity, and engineering.
Strong knowledge of project management principles, enterprise information systems, resource planning, and technology implementation practices.
Proven ability to develop project plans, coordinate resources, manage risks, resolve issues, and deliver complex initiatives within established timelines and requirements.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills, including the ability to engage effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, sound judgment, and the capacity to independently determine solutions and make project-level decisions under general direction.
Experience coordinating technical and business activities across the full project lifecycle, from requirements and planning through testing, deployment, and operational adoption.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting cybersecurity governance, regulatory compliance, or security-focused IT programs.
A track record of delivering complex enterprise technology solutions involving multiple business and technical teams.
Experience managing data migrations, performance metrics, dashboards, testing, training, or deployment initiatives.
Familiarity with enterprise systems supporting manufacturing, supply chain, finance, procurement, or similar business functions.
Experience using project management and delivery platforms such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Planisware, Post Grey, and/or ServiceNow.
A proactive, adaptable approach to project leadership, with a commitment to continuous improvement and effective change management.

Benefits

Competitive annual salary: Base compensation ranging from $103,600 to $155,400, depending on experience, qualifications, skills, responsibilities, and market conditions.
Healthcare coverage: Access to health insurance and comprehensive healthcare benefits.
Life and disability insurance: Coverage designed to provide additional financial protection.
Retirement savings: Access to a 401(k) savings plan with employer matching.
Paid time off: Paid vacation, personal leave, and company-paid holidays.
Flexible work arrangements: Remote work opportunities and flexible scheduling options.
Alternative work schedule: Access to a 9/80 schedule option, allowing eligible employees to work nine-hour days over two weeks and receive an additional day off.
Performance-based rewards: Depending on eligibility, additional compensation may include discretionary bonuses and other incentives.
Professional development: Learning opportunities, exposure to diverse projects and stakeholders, and resources to support career advancement.
Collaborative work environment: The opportunity to work with experienced professionals on enterprise technology initiatives that support important business and operational objectives.
Travel requirements: Approximately 10% travel may be required.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager II - Navy Federal Financial Group
new_jobs.description:
Overview

To plan, manage, and execute all aspects of life-cycle projects from inception through implementation. To develop project plans and deliver solutions on schedule and within budget in support of service innovations and organizational and process changes/enhancements.

Responsibilities

Ensures effective management of projects from inception through implementation
Defines, develops and executes project plans, including scope definition, expectations, activities, cost estimates, and schedules
Works with the business group to determine and understand business requirements
Manages projects from concept through the planning, analysis, design, testing, implementation, and transition phases
Develops clear and concise "big picture" of projects within Navy Federal organizational goals
Directs and leads Project Teams by developing and coordinating work plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and training
Manages project budgets including risk and impact of changes to project plans
Identifies and minimizes project risks or constraints that would impact project deliverables
Identifies, communicates, and resolves branch/division/department areas of concern, or cross-organizational that may impede or impact other projects/initiatives
Maintains/archives project documentation
Ensures project deliverables are met in accordance with customers' expectations
Sets, manages, and communicates client expectations for the project
Oversees project progress to ensure project documentation and schedules are in compliance with previously agreed requirements and standards
Identifies, escalates and/or resolves issues associated with project(s) ensuring deliverables conform to established quality and schedules
Monitors and controls risks to ensure timelines are met and project goals are attained
Facilitates project team and client meetings for the resolution of project issues
Provides project status reports to management
Ensures success of projects by working closely with Procurement regarding vendor contracts
Works closely with Procurement to clearly define and understand contracts, including language, scope, pre- and post-award, contract closure, basic legal aspects, and risk management
Manages contracts' quality assurance, including contract administration and execution
Manages contract budget, cost control mechanisms and Change control
Serves as primary point of contact for project management and related issues.
Secures resources and ensures optimum utilization of those resources, meeting budgetary requirements
Allocates project team assignments to ensure accountability, establishes a team environment, manages personnel changes, and executes the training plan
Manages, executes, and communicates project plan, changes, direction, approach, and priorities based on changing business requirements, circumstances, new information and/or budget considerations to stakeholders
Establishes team objectives and assignments, reviews work products, and provides timely feedback to staff regarding performance; may provide input to team members' performance appraisals
Promotes team building and skills development of project team members
Manages multiple, moderately complex projects
Solves moderate to complex project-related problems
Interacts effectively with managers and division/department management concerning projects
Participates with division/department management in researching and selecting vendors
Recommends improvements across division/department lines
Builds relationships with management and key stakeholders
Manages relationships with vendors, including contract definition, monitoring and issue resolution
Performs other related duties as assigned

Qualifications

Experience leading and/or managing small projects or portions of larger projects
Experience participating in, and/or managing, cross-functional, multi-dimensional teams and projects
Solid knowledge of project lifecycles, project management methodologies, and business requirements analysis
Experience working with all levels of staff, management, and vendors
Knowledge and understanding of contracts, including language, intricacies, scope, and risk management
Proficiency with PCs and related software applications (word processing, spreadsheet, presentation, database, and project management applications)
Strong planning, organization, and problem solving skills
Demonstrated skill in leading, guiding, and mentoring others
Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
Demonstrated skill in effectively building relationships with and influence team members, management, vendors, and a diverse group of stakeholders
Demonstrated skill in presenting findings and conclusions clearly and concisely to stakeholders and management
Bachelor's degree in a related field or the equivalent combination of education, training, or experience

Desired Qualifications

Advanced Degree in Business, Management, Economics, Finance, or related field
Knowledge of Navy Federal's, or other financial institutions', operations
Working knowledge of Navy Federal's Project Portfolio Management (PPM) standards
Extensive experience managing multi-disciplinary project lifecycles for financial institutions
Familiarity with financial services operating models, including brokerage, registered investment advisory (RIA), and/or financial planning environments, with the ability to apply that understanding to Navy Federal Financial Group’s integrated service model.

Significant experience in delivering complex IT projects involving infrastructure, cybersecurity, or regulatory compliance

new_jobs.description:
Business Analyst – AI-Enabled Requirements Engineering
We are seeking an AI-enabled Business Analyst to partner with product teams, engineering, quality assurance, clients, and other stakeholders to analyze, document, and validate functional and technical requirements for new and existing software. This individual will independently translate high-level business needs into detailed use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows, data requirements, and integration scenarios that provide developers and testers with clear, actionable direction. The analyst will also support production issue analysis by reviewing system behavior, workflows, data, SQL, APIs, logs, and integration mappings before engaging developers for deeper technical investigation.
The Business Analyst will use AI tools to accelerate the creation and review of requirements, identify gaps, conflicts, dependencies, duplicates, and missing edge cases, and propose clarifying questions. Responsibilities will include cross-model validation of AI-generated specifications, translation of business requirements into technical specifications, pseudocode, API payload examples, and data mappings, as well as AI-assisted validation of SQL queries, API structures, and integrations. The analyst will facilitate stakeholder discussions, coordinate across scrum teams, document meeting outcomes, prepare status reports and presentations, support backlog refinement and testing activities, and create user guides, help documentation, and other delivery materials while ensuring all AI-generated content is independently reviewed for accuracy, security, privacy, and alignment with business intent.
Required Skills:
• Experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role in an Agile software development environment.
• Demonstrated ability to write detailed user stories, use cases, functional specifications, and comprehensive acceptance criteria.
• Ability to independently analyze requirements, workflows, system behavior, integrations, and initial production issues.
• Working knowledge of APIs, JSON/XML, SQL, data mappings, integrations, and software development life cycles and ability to write API technical user stories
• Experience identifying requirements gaps, conflicts, dependencies, assumptions, duplicates, and edge cases.
• Practical experience using generative AI tools for requirements analysis, documentation, validation, or software delivery.
• Ability to perform cross-model validation and critically evaluate AI-generated requirements and specifications.
• Strong facilitation, communication, documentation, organization, and presentation skills.
• Experience collaborating with product managers, developers, testers, clients, and cross-functional teams.
• Ability to distinguish confirmed facts, assumptions, hypotheses, and items requiring further technical investigation.
Preferred Skills:
• Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar requirements and documentation tools.
• Experience validating REST APIs using Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, or equivalent tools.
• Experience writing, reviewing, or validating SQL queries.
• Experience with system integrations, data migration, microservices, event-driven architectures, or legacy modernization.
• Experience with test case design, automated testing, or behavior-driven development.
• Experience creating reusable AI prompts, workflows, or quality gates.
• Familiarity with multiple AI models and techniques for comparing model-generated outputs.
• Experience using AI to map legacy system behavior to modern design patterns, APIs, or service boundaries.
• Experience facilitating backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and stakeholder workshops.
• Business analysis, product management, Agile, or related professional certification.

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour.

Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, deux choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer.

Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations

Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins.

L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Elle accompagne chaque hôpital dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration.

Notre équipe est composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, tous pilotés par Loïc, notre Lead Customer Operations.

Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un profil à la croisée de la technique et de la gestion de projet : une personne capable de piloter un déploiement client de bout en bout, mais aussi de prendre en main les aspects techniques de l'intégration de nos solutions.

Si tu aimes autant comprendre comment fonctionnent les systèmes informatiques que coordonner les parties prenantes d'un projet, ce poste devrait te plaire !

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

En tant que Technical Implementation Manager, tu seras responsable de la mise en œuvre technique de nos solutions dans les établissements de santé, depuis le cadrage initial jusqu'à leur mise en production.

Ton rôle ? Faire en sorte que nos solutions s'intègrent correctement dans les systèmes d'information hospitaliers, tout en garantissant le bon déroulement des déploiements.

Concrètement, tu seras amené(e) à :

🔧 Piloter et réaliser les déploiements techniques

Configurer et déployer nos applications dans les environnements informatiques de nos clients.
Mettre en place et configurer les flux d'interopérabilité entre nos solutions et les systèmes d'information hospitaliers (notamment HL7).
Travailler avec les équipes IT des établissements sur les prérequis techniques : serveurs Windows, réseau, connectivité, VPN, SFTP, certificats et sécurité.
Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes techniques rencontrés lors des installations et des mises en production.

📋 Gérer tes projets d'implémentation de bout en bout

Organiser et animer les réunions de cadrage technique avec les établissements de santé.
Identifier les besoins, les contraintes et les prérequis techniques nécessaires au déploiement.
Coordonner les différents interlocuteurs (DSI, équipes techniques hospitalières, chefs de projet, équipes internes Lifen) pour assurer la bonne avancée des projets.
Suivre les différentes étapes du déploiement, anticiper les risques, lever les blocages et garantir la qualité des mises en production.

🔍 Garantir le bon fonctionnement de nos solutions

Réaliser les tests techniques et fonctionnels avec les clients afin de valider le bon fonctionnement de nos solutions de bout en bout.
Analyser les incidents et identifier leur origine (configuration, connectivité, flux, application...).
Assurer le support technique de niveau 2 en collaboration avec les équipes Support, Produit et R&D.
Surveiller les flux et les certificats pour anticiper les dysfonctionnements.

🤝 Être un interlocuteur technique de confiance pour nos clients

Développer progressivement une expertise sur l'ensemble de nos produits.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons avant tout un profil technique qui aime gérer des projets, résoudre des problèmes concrets et travailler directement avec les clients.

🖥️ De solides bases techniques

Tu as une expérience pratique dans le déploiement, l'intégration ou l'administration de solutions logicielles et tu es à l'aise avec plusieurs des environnements et technologies suivants :

Systèmes : environnements Windows Server, administration système, GPO, installation et configuration d'applications.
Réseaux et connectivité : TCP/IP, VPN, SFTP, certificats et notions de sécurité informatique.
Intégration applicative : compréhension des échanges de données entre applications, des flux et des problématiques d'interopérabilité.
Diagnostic technique : capacité à analyser des logs, identifier l'origine d'un incident et conduire sa résolution.

Tu n'as pas besoin d'être expert(e) sur chacune de ces technologies, mais tu dois avoir suffisamment de bagage technique pour être autonome face aux problématiques d'un déploiement.

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities

Role Summary

The Senior Technical Program Manager, Hardware Strategy & Operations combines technical program management, leadership operations, and portfolio planning for the Advanced Technology Labs Hardware organization. The individual will partner closely with the Hardware VP and leadership team to drive execution of critical technical initiatives, support technology investment and resource planning decisions, and establish the operating mechanisms needed to align resources, decisions, and organizational priorities.

This role requires a strong blend of technical credibility, operational excellence, business judgment, and cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will help ensure key organizational priorities are aligned, executed, and delivered while supporting long-term technology and business objectives.

Core Responsibilities

Technical Program Execution

Lead program management for critical hardware technology initiatives, managing risks and establishing frameworks to ensure effective cross-functional alignment and execution.
Facilitate coordination among R&D, Finance, Product Planning, Manufacturing, HR, and business organizations to drive execution of strategic initiatives and commitments.

Program Manager, Free Tax Help
new_jobs.description:
About United Way Bay Area

United Way Bay Area (UWBA) mobilizes the Bay Area to dismantle the root causes of poverty and build equitable pathways to prosperity. UWBA brings together partners from the nonprofit, business, and government sectors to address Bay Area poverty. We partner across sectors, develop solutions, capture the data we need, and use those insights to support public policy and create research-backed community initiatives. These initiatives include:

Housing Justice: Improve access to stable, affordable housing and homelessness prevention.
Employment & Career Opportunities: Build systems and pathways to career and employment opportunities.
Financial Stability: Help families increase income and savings on their way to financial stability.
Basic Needs: Ensure access to basic needs like food, housing, and legal services.

United Way Bay Area (UWBA) is leading a network of corporations, government agencies, nonprofits, and individuals to create lasting change for Bay Area residents and families. With a history that spans over 100 years and programs that tackle the issue of local poverty from every angle, UWBA is uniquely positioned to mobilize and motivate all sectors of the community toward the vision of ending the cycle of poverty.

About The Role

The Program Manager plays a key leadership role in supporting the success, quality, and sustainability of the Free Tax Help coalition. Initially hired as a seasonal position, this role has the potential to evolve into a year-round position based on organizational needs, funding, and performance.

The Program Manager oversees assigned program areas, partner organizations, and VITA sites while providing leadership, coaching, and technical assistance to site coordinators and volunteers. This position ensures high-quality, compliant service delivery while strengthening partner capacity, improving operational effectiveness, and enhancing the volunteer and client experience.

We are seeking a collaborative, strategic, and mission-driven leader who thrives in dynamic environments and is passionate about strengthening communities through equitable access to free tax preparation services.

The successful candidate is someone who takes ownership, exercises sound judgment, and can be entrusted with complex responsibilities. They assess challenges, ask thoughtful questions, develop practical solutions, follow established guidelines and procedures, collaborate effectively with stakeholders, and independently drive work to completion with minimal supervision. They are proactive, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement while maintaining compliance, operational excellence, and exceptional service delivery.

This is a part-time position. Candidates must be based in the Bay Area, California and be able to attend in-person events as part of this hybrid role.

What You'll Do

Coalition & Partner Site Management

Manage assigned counties, partner organizations, and VITA sites.
Serve as the primary liaison and trusted advisor to assigned site coordinators.
Build collaborative relationships while promoting accountability, consistency, and shared success.
Conduct site visits and provide operational coaching and technical assistance.
Support onboarding and development of new site coordinators and partner organizations.
Assess operational capacity, identify opportunities for improvement, and help partners implement sustainable solutions.
Identify risks, anticipate challenges, and proactively develop solutions.

Volunteer & Program Operations

Support volunteer recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and retention initiatives.
Help sites maximize volunteer capacity and operational effectiveness while promoting sustainable service models.
Collaborate on special initiatives, including virtual tax preparation and coalition-wide projects.
Foster positive volunteer and coordinator experiences that encourage long-term engagement.

Tax Law, Compliance & Quality Assurance

Serve as a technical resource for tax law questions, client screening, and scope determinations.
Support resolution of complex tax situations and operational issues.
Ensure adherence to IRS VITA/TCE Quality Site Requirements, grant requirements, coalition policies, and operational procedures.
Reinforce consistent implementation of established standards while supporting continuous improvement.

Training & Capacity Building

Deliver training, coaching, and technical assistance to volunteers and site coordinators.
Develop and maintain training materials, guides, and operational resources.
Promote knowledge sharing, leadership development, and continuous learning throughout the coalition.

Project & Process Management

Lead multiple projects with competing priorities and deadlines.
Document, evaluate, and improve operational processes to increase efficiency, consistency, and sustainability.
Support implementation and adoption of technology platforms, CRM systems, and online tools.
Maintain organization, accountability, and follow-through while working independently in a remote environment.

Data, Reporting & Community Impact

Support grant reporting, data collection, and program evaluation.
Monitor performance metrics and identify opportunities to strengthen coalition capacity.
Capture qualitative stories and community impact that complement production metrics and demonstrate program value to funders and stakeholders.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess the following experience, knowledge and skills: 

Leadership & Ownership

Takes initiative and assumes ownership of projects and responsibilities.
Independently manages priorities and drives work to completion with minimal supervision.
Exercises sound judgment and demonstrates accountability.

Strategic Thinking

Uses data, observation, and thoughtful inquiry to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and develop sustainable solutions.
Thinks beyond immediate tasks to strengthen long-term coalition capacity and effectiveness.

Operational Excellence

Strong project management, organizational, and time management skills.
Balances multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality work.
Continuously evaluates and improves processes to increase efficiency and sustainability.

Compliance & Quality

Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail.
Consistently follows established guidelines, procedures, quality standards, grant requirements, and IRS regulations.
Understands when strict adherence to procedures is required, when issues should be escalated, and when process improvements should be recommended.

Adaptability

Successfully responds to changing priorities, funding environments, tax law updates, and operational needs.
Demonstrates flexibility while maintaining quality and compliance.

Relationship Management

Builds trust and credibility with partner organizations, volunteers, site coordinators, and colleagues.
Provides coaching, technical assistance, and constructive feedback with professionalism and respect.

Learning Agility

Quickly learns complex tax law, technology, regulations, and operational procedures.
Translates technical information into practical guidance for volunteers, partners, and site coordinators.

Continuous Improvement

Demonstrates curiosity by asking thoughtful questions, identifying root causes, and seeking opportunities to strengthen coalition operations.
Preserves practices that add value while improving those that can better support volunteers, partners, clients, and organizational sustainability.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with IRS Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) or other compliance-driven community service programs.
Experience preparing individual income tax returns and providing tax law guidance.
IRS Advanced Certification or ability to obtain certification.
Experience supervising volunteers or supporting community-based partnerships.
Experience with grant-funded programs, CRM systems, or volunteer management platforms.
Bilingual proficiency in Spanish, Chinese (Mandarin or Cantonese), or Vietnamese preferred.

This position is covered under a collective bargaining agreement and is represented by OPEIU, Local 29.

The model considers role scope, responsibilities, and documented compensable factors, and includes equity checks across the organization. As part of this approach, we do not engage in salary negotiations.
